jobs.title: Research Scientist - Complex Systems Modelling for Reliability (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   At Hitachi Energy Research, we are shaping the energy systems of tomorrow. As the power grid evolves into a complex, digital “system of systems” integrating renewable energy, power electronics, and distributed assets, ensuring long-term reliability and availability becomes a central challenge. We are looking for a Scientist in Reliability Modelling to drive innovation in system-level reliability modelling and lifecycle optimization of power grid components and system, large-scale power grid infrastructures, including emerging application in challenging environments to help development of sustainable energy sources and their integration to the power grid of the future. How you'll make an impact   System-Level Reliability Modelling Innovation:  Drive the translation of innovative ideas advanced methodologies for reliability, availability, maintainability, and safety (RAMS) modelling integrating single-asset physical knowledge into modelling to represent interdependencies, redundancy, and system-of-systems behavior Data-driven and Physics based Decision Support:  Contribute to methodologies such as Reliability-Centered Maintenance and reliability twin concepts for decision-making under uncertainty with far reaching impact on GW level power systems over decades of operation Scientific Leadership  Collaborate with a global and interdisciplinary team of researchers and engineers across research and business units to identify, shape, and solve impactful industrial challenges Cross-Functional Collaboration:  Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities, technologies and products suppliers Scientific Communication & Innovation:  Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports    Your background    PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Reliability Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related field Systems thinker capable of bridging component-level physics and system-level performance. Strong expertise in system-level reliability modelling (RAMS, RBD, FTA, Monte Carlo, stochastic modelling) Experience with complex engineering systems (energy, aerospace, automotive, or similar high-reliability domains). Including knowledge of maintenance strategies and lifecycle optimization for repairable systems Familiarity with power grid technologies (HVDC, substations, converters) is an advantage but not strictly required Proven track record at top scientific conferences and journal publications Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity More about us   At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every individual. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Join us in shaping a more sustainable and reliable energy future.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità di Hitachi Energy Research, stiamo plasmando i sistemi energetici di domani. Poiché la rete elettrica si evolve in un complesso e digitale “sistema di sistemi” che integra energia rinnovabile, elettronica di potenza e asset distribuiti, garantendo affidabilità e disponibilità a lungo termine diventa una sfida centrale. Siamo alla ricerca di uno scienziato in Reliability Modelling per guidare l'innovazione nella modellazione dell'affidabilità a livello di sistema e l'ottimizzazione del ciclo di vita dei componenti e del sistema della rete elettrica, le infrastrutture della rete elettrica su larga scala, inclusa l'applicazione emergente in ambienti difficili per aiutare lo sviluppo di fonti energetiche sostenibili e la loro integrazione alla rete elettrica del futuro. Come farete un impatto Modello di Affidabilità System-Level Innovazione: Guidare la traduzione di idee innovative metodologie avanzate di collaborazione per l'affidabilità, la disponibilità, la manutenbilità e la sicurezza (RAMS) modellando l'integrazione della conoscenza fisica single-asset nella modellazione per rappresentare interdipendenze, ridondanza, e il comportamento di sistema-di-sistemi Data-driven e Fisica basato Sostegno decisionale: Contribuire a metodologie quali Reliability-Centered Manutenzione e l'affidabilità concetti gemelli per il processo decisionale a livello globale Costruire relazioni all'interno dell'azienda e condividere attivamente le vostre conoscenze e competenze. Interagisci con partner esterni locali e globali, tra cui università, tecnologie e fornitori di prodotti Comunicazione scientifica e innovazione: Dissemina i tuoi risultati in pubblicazioni scientifiche, applicazioni di brevetti e relazioni tecniche Il tuo dottorato di ricerca in Ingegneria Elettrica, Sistemi di Potere, Ingegneria di Affidabilità, Matematica Applicata, Fisica, o il relativo campo Pensatore di sistemi in grado di bridging fisica a livello di componenti e prestazioni a livello di sistema. Forte esperienza nella modellazione di affidabilità a livello di sistema (RAMS, RBD, FTA, Monte Carlo, modellazione stocastica) Esperienza con complessi sistemi di ingegneria (energia, aerospaziale, automotive, o simili domini ad alta affidabilità). Compresa la conoscenza delle strategie di manutenzione e l'ottimizzazione del ciclo di vita per sistemi riparabili La familiarità con le tecnologie della rete elettrica (HVDC, sottostazioni, convertitori) è un vantaggio ma non strettamente necessario Proven track record in migliori conferenze scientifiche e pubblicazioni di riviste Le eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese, l'atteggiamento del giocatore di squadra, l'iniziativa e la creatività Più su di noi A Hitachi Energy, crediamo nella potenza della diversità e nel potenziale di ogni individuo. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo dove tutti possano prosperare. Unisciti a noi nella definizione di un futuro energetico più sostenibile e affidabile.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Bei Hitachi Energy Research gestalten wir die Energiesysteme von morgen. Da sich das Stromnetz zu einem komplexen, digitalen System von Systemen entwickelt, das erneuerbare Energien, Leistungselektronik und verteilte Anlagen integriert, wird die Gewährleistung der langfristigen Zuverlässigkeit und Verfügbarkeit zu einer zentralen Herausforderung. Wir suchen einen Wissenschaftler für Zuverlässigkeitsmodellierung, um Innovationen in der Zuverlässigkeitsmodellierung auf Systemebene und der Lebenszyklusoptimierung von Stromnetzkomponenten und -systemen sowie großen Stromnetzinfrastrukturen voranzutreiben, einschließlich neuer Anwendungen in herausfordernden Umgebungen, um die Entwicklung nachhaltiger Energiequellen und ihre Integration in das Stromnetz der Zukunft zu unterstützen. Wie Sie die Innovation der Zuverlässigkeitsmodellierung auf Systemebene beeinflussen: Förderung der Übersetzung innovativer Ideen fortschrittliche Methoden für Zuverlässigkeit, Verfügbarkeit, Wartbarkeit und Sicherheit (RAMS) Modellierung Integration von Single-Asset-physikalischen Wissen in Modellierung Interdependenzen, Redundanz und System-of-System-Verhalten Datengesteuerte und Physik-basierte Entscheidungsunterstützung: Beitrag zu Methoden wie Zuverlässigkeitszentrierte Wartung und Zuverlässigkeit Zwillingskonzepte für die Entscheidungsfindung unter Unsicherheit mit weitreichenden Auswirkungen auf GW-Level-Power-Systeme über Jahrzehnte des Betriebs Wissenschaftliche Führung Zusammenarbeit mit einem globalen und interdisziplinären Team von Forschern und Ingenieuren in Forschung und Geschäftseinheiten, um wirkungsvolle industrielle Herausforderungen zu identifizieren, zu gestalten und zu lösen Funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Bauen Sie Beziehungen innerhalb des Unternehmens auf und teilen Sie aktiv Ihr Wissen und Ihre Expertise. Interagieren Sie mit lokalen und globalen externen Partnern, einschließlich Universitäten, Technologie- und Produktlieferanten Wissenschaftliche Kommunikation & Innovation: Verbreiten Sie Ihre Ergebnisse in wissenschaftlichen Publikationen, Patentanmeldungen und technischen Berichten Ihr Hintergrund PhD in Elektrotechnik, Energiesysteme, Zuverlässigkeitstechnik, Angewandte Mathematik, Physik oder verwandte Feld Systemdenker, der in der Lage ist, die Komponentenebene Physik und Systemebene Leistung zu verbinden. Starke Expertise in der Zuverlässigkeitsmodellierung auf Systemebene (RAMS, RBD, FTA, Monte Carlo, stochastische Modellierung) Erfahrung mit komplexen Engineering-Systemen (Energie, Luft- und Raumfahrt, Automobil oder ähnliche Bereiche mit hoher Zuverlässigkeit). Einschließlich des Wissens über Wartungsstrategien und Lebenszyklusoptimierung für reparierbare Systeme Die Vertrautheit mit Stromnetztechnologien (HVDC, Umspannwerke, Konverter) ist ein Vorteil, aber nicht unbedingt erforderlich Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz auf führenden wissenschaftlichen Konferenzen und Zeitschriftenpublikationen Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch, Teamplayer-Haltung, Initiative und Kreativität Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy glauben wir an die Kraft der Vielfalt und das Potenzial jedes Einzelnen. Wir sind bestrebt, ein integratives Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem jeder gedeihen kann. Gestalten Sie mit uns eine nachhaltigere und zuverlässigere Energiezukunft.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Chez Hitachi Energy Research, nous façonnons les systèmes énergétiques de demain. À mesure que le réseau se transforme en un système complexe et numérique de systèmes intégrant les énergies renouvelables, l'électronique électrique et les actifs distribués, assurer la fiabilité et la disponibilité à long terme devient un défi central. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un scientifique en modélisation de fiabilité pour stimuler l'innovation dans la modélisation de la fiabilité au niveau du système et l'optimisation du cycle de vie des composants et du système du réseau électrique, des infrastructures de réseau électrique à grande échelle, y compris des applications émergentes dans des environnements difficiles pour aider au développement de sources d'énergie durables et leur intégration au réseau électrique de l'avenir. Comment vous ferez un impact Système-niveau de fiabilité Modélisation Innovation: Conduire l'application d'idées innovantes des méthodologies avancées pour la modélisation de la fiabilité, de la disponibilité, de la maintenance et de la sécurité (RAMS) intégrant les connaissances physiques d'un seul actif dans la modélisation afin de représenter les interdépendances, la redondance et le comportement du système des systèmes.Appui à la décision fondé sur les données et la physique.Contribuer à des méthodologies telles que le maintien de la fiabilité et les concepts jumelés de fiabilité pour la prise de décisions dans des conditions d'incertitude, avec un impact considérable sur les systèmes d'alimentation au niveau GW au cours de décennies d'exploitation. Leadership scientifique Collaborer avec une équipe mondiale et interdisciplinaire de chercheurs et d'ingénieurs dans les unités de recherche et d'entreprises pour identifier, façonner et résoudre les défis industriels pertinents. Établir des relations au sein de l'entreprise et partager activement vos connaissances et votre expertise. Interagir avec des partenaires externes locaux et mondiaux, y compris des universités, des fournisseurs de technologies et de produits Communication scientifique et innovation : Diffuser vos résultats dans des publications scientifiques, des demandes de brevet et des rapports techniques Votre doctorat en génie électrique, systèmes d'alimentation, génie de la fiabilité, mathématiques appliquées, physique ou domaine connexe. Forte expertise en modélisation de la fiabilité au niveau du système (RAMS, RBD, FTA, Monte Carlo, modélisation stochastique) Expérience des systèmes d'ingénierie complexes (énergie, aérospatiale, automobile ou domaines similaires à haute fiabilité). Inclure la connaissance des stratégies d'entretien et l'optimisation du cycle de vie pour les systèmes réparables La familiarité avec les technologies du réseau électrique (HVDC, sous-stations, convertisseurs) est un avantage mais pas strictement requis Une expérience éprouvée dans les meilleures conférences scientifiques et publications de revues Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais, attitude de joueur d'équipe, initiative et créativité Plus sur nous Chez Hitachi Énergie, nous croyons en la puissance de la diversité et le potentiel de chaque individu. Nous sommes déterminés à créer un environnement inclusif où chacun puisse prospérer. Rejoignez-nous pour façonner un avenir énergétique plus durable et plus fiable.

jobs.title: Factory Continuous Improvement Specialist 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Factory Continuous Improvement Specialist for the Business Unit Transformers to join our team driving operational excellence and Lean transformation in Satigny. In this role, you will support the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives at the factory level by facilitating projects, Kaizen events, and capability-building activities that deliver measurable impact. You will have the opportunity to strengthen your expertise in Lean methodologies and coach employees while shaping a culture of continuous improvement. This role offers a strong foundation for your career growth and allows you to make a meaningful contribution to building a more sustainable future. How you will make an impact Lead and execute factory continuous improvement projects and Kaizen events that deliver measurable impact Apply Lean methodologies to identify opportunities and implement solutions that enhance efficiency and quality Ensure compliance with governance standards by supporting audits, maturity assessments, and corrective actions Integrate the Voice of the Customer into improvement initiatives and support structured problem-solving to meet expectations Collect and analyze performance data to track KPIs and prepare dashboards that provide clear visibility of progress Train and coach employees on Lean methods and structured problem-solving to build capability across the factory Calculate and report savings and benefits from improvement projects and Kaizen events to ensure transparency and alignment with targets Provide guidance and support to factory teams to ensure consistent application of continuous improvement practices and strengthen operational performance Your background Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management, or related field Minimum 2–4 years of experience in Continuous Improvement, Lean, or Operational Excellence roles, preferably in a manufacturing environment Proficiency in Lean and Six Sigma tools (Green Belt certification) Strong facilitation and problem-solving skills to lead Kaizen events and improvement initiatives Analytical skills for data collection, KPI tracking, and ROI reporting Effective communication and coaching skills to engage factory teams and promote CI practices Fluency in French and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize both your personal and professional performance and create an environment where all employees can develop and grow

jobs.title: Project Management Engineering e-Mobility 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity Join our dynamic Engineering team in Regional Center of Competence, Europe Hub, as a Project Manager Engineering and lead technically the execution and tendering of cutting-edge eMobility electric power supply infrastructure projects—including DC charging solutions for electric buses. You'll shape technical solutions, lead engineering efforts across MV & LV distribution systems and power conversion equipment and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to drive innovation and excellence. If you're passionate about sustainable mobility and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, this is your chance to make a real impact. How you'll make an impact Take technical lead in execution and tendering of eMobility electrical infrastructure projects (e.g., bus depots, terminal charging stations), support and guide Local execution and tendering teams Own all engineering activities across project lifecycles—from concept to commissioning Collaborate internally with Local Operating Units responsible for project execution and tendering, Sales, R&D, Product engineers, Supply chain, Site Installation & Commissioning teams and externally with customers, suppliers Coordinate and supervise remote engineering teams for primary and secondary engineering tasks as applicable Design power supply system architectures, perform sizing calculations, and prepare technical specifications Evaluate supplier offers and support procurement processes with Supply Chain Management Provide technical expertise during tendering and project execution phases Translate customer requirements into optimized, compliant technical solutions Lead technical discussions with clients, resolve site queries, and ensure timely, high-quality deliverables Ensure safety, compliance, and engineering excellence throughout the project Your background Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, with a focus on Power Electronics or Power Systems 7–10 years of experience in MV\/LV power distribution systems, electrical systems design & engineering Experience with DC power supply systems, power converters, energy storage, or harmonic filtering is a plus Strong knowledge of engineering tools and software (e.g., BIM, CAD, ETAP, MathCAD) Proactive, results-driven mindset with strong teamwork and communication skills Committed to safety, quality, and continuous learning Willingness to travel up to 10% for customer and project meetings Fluent in English and French More about us 
• We offer a competitive Swiss benefits package designed to support your professional growth and well‑being. Depending on experience and role, this may include: Pension and insurance plans Performance‑based bonus Flexible working arrangements Learning and development opportunities

jobs.title: Network and Security Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity In this challenging role, you will design the network and security architecture for communication networks used in power utilities, wind farms, and other critical infrastructure, based on the modern technology standards. How you'll make an impact You will develop systems in compliance with security standards such as IEC 62443 and NERC-CIP You will implement planned cybersecurity measures on devices and applications You will support the sales organization during the tender phase and in customer discussions With your technical expertise, you will assist the project manager and coordinate with both customers and internal stakeholders You will prepare procedures and operational manuals tailored to customer requirements You will conduct risk assessments as part of project execution, in alignment with IEC 62443, to identify and evaluate cybersecurity risks within industrial automation systems and ensure appropriate security measures are implemented Your background You have a degree in power engineering, electrical engineering, information technology, or equivalent professional experience, along with experience in communication networks and system architectures in industrial or infrastructure environments You are proficient in cybersecurity technologies, LAN\/WAN networks, peripheral devices, and operating systems including MS Windows (Server, AD) and Linux You demonstrate strong communication skills, team spirit, and the ability to work independently Excellent command of English is required You are motivated to help build a new business area and actively support the transition to a cybersecure work approach, assisting engineers in adopting cybersecurity best practices More about us We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità In questo ruolo impegnativo, si progetta la rete e l'architettura di sicurezza per le reti di comunicazione utilizzate nelle utenze elettriche, nelle fattorie eoliche e in altre infrastrutture critiche, basate sugli standard tecnologici moderni. jobs.description:
The opportunity Join an innovative and collaborative engineering team shaping the future of high-voltage technology. You will contribute to the development of next-generation SF6-free circuit breakers in a supportive and knowledge-sharing environment. jobs.description:
The opportunity You as Junior Integrity Professional will be part of Hitachi Energy business based in Zurich. We are seeking a dynamic and motivated Junior professional to join our Integrity Team for a fixed term of 18 months. You will participate in our specialized learning program, aimed at developing the skills and knowledge necessary for a successful integrity career within a global company. You will be exposed to a variety of matters and projects, with opportunities to be involved in local, regional, and global projects. In this position, you will be part of our Integrity Function reporting to the Global Head of Integrity and will contribute to implementing global initiatives and ensure complete adherence to Group directives and local statutory regulations. How you'll make an impact Participating in the development and implementation of integrity strategies, specially related to process and procedures, using of AI and\/or tech programs Conducting research and prepare Integrity documents, specially related to continuous\/process improvement Supporting the implementation of the Code of Conduct and assist in ongoing integrity training Assisting the Global Head of Integrity in providing advice to Hitachi Energy management across a broad range of Integrity issues or within a specialist area Ensuring compliance with company policies and Group directives, assist with the developing and implementation of both local and group legal and integrity directives and instructions, and monitor ongoing integrity, executing due diligence Managing and communicating with external service providers Participating in various global, regional, and local projects within the department Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business ​ Your background          Graduate degree in Law, Business Administration, Forensic Accounting or related field Maximum 2 years of experience after graduation Demonstrated ability to be agile and keen to learn as well as good communication and interpersonal skills Strong interest in AI, technology, and process improvement High level of integrity and ethical standards Proficiency in both spoken & written English language More about us We are a technology ‑ driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing.

jobs.title: Logistiker/in 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position In dieser Rolle bist du ein zentraler Bestandteil unserer internen Logistik und stellst einen reibungslosen Materialfluss innerhalb des Unternehmens sicher. Du arbeitest mit modernen Logistiksystemen, bewirtschaftest Warenbewegungen im SAP EWM und sorgst dafür, dass Produktion und interne Schnittstellen jederzeit optimal versorgt sind. Mit deiner sorgfältigen und zuverlässigen Arbeitsweise trägst du wesentlich zur Effizienz, Sicherheit und Ordnung auf dem gesamten Betriebsgelände bei. Das kannst du bewirken
• Buchung von Wareneingängen und Inbounds im SAP EWM System
• Beschriften, Labeln und Verschachteln von Waren auf Handling Units
• Einlagerung und Umlagerung von Waren mittels mobiler Geräte
• Bereitstellung und Distribution von Produktionsmaterial innerhalb des Betriebs
• Versorgung der Produktionslinien mit Chemie-Kleingebinden sowie Sicherstellung des Nachschubs
• Bewirtschaftung von Recycling-, Abfall- und Logistikelementen (z. B. Mulden, Pressen, Paletten)
• Durchführung interner Transporte unter Einhaltung der Sicherheits- und Handlingsvorschriften
• Kommissionierung von Produktionsmaterial für verschiedene Werke sowie Sicherstellung von Ordnung und Sauberkeit Das bringst du mit
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Logistiker\/in oder vergleichbare Ausbildung, idealerweise mit Berufserfahrung
• Gute Kenntnisse in SAP EWM sowie sicherer Umgang mit PC-Anwendungen (Windows, Outlook)
• Staplerausweis und Erfahrung im Umgang mit Flurförderfahrzeugen
• Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie grundlegende Englischkenntnisse
• Selbstständige, zuverlässige und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise
• Hohes Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein Mehr über uns Hitachi Energy ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Energie und Elektrifizierung und gestaltet die Energiezukunft aktiv mit. An unserem Standort erwartet dich ein modernes, sicheres und teamorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld mit attraktiven Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

jobs.title: Konstrukteur/in 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position In unserem Werk in Zürich Örlikon entwickelst und konstruierst du innovative Produkte und Komponenten für die Energieübertragung der Zukunft. In dieser Rolle arbeitest du eng mit Engineering, Produktion, Einkauf und Projektmanagement zusammen und begleitest technische Lösungen von der Konzeptphase bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung. Mit deinem technischen Know-how und deiner Kreativität leistest du einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Qualität, Effizienz und Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte.     Das kannst du bewirken
• Erstellen und Pflegen von 3D-Modellen, Baugruppen, Fertigungszeichnungen und Stücklisten für Produkte und Komponenten
• Entwickeln, Auslegen und Optimieren technischer Lösungen unter Berücksichtigung von Qualität, Kosten, Terminen und Fertigbarkeit
• Technische Unterstützung von Produktion, Einkauf, Qualität und Projektmanagement bei konstruktiven Fragestellungen
• Durchführen von Machbarkeitsstudien, technischen Berechnungen und Toleranzanalysen
• Mitarbeit bei Produktanpassungen, Neuentwicklungen sowie der Standardisierung von Komponenten und Baugruppen
• Pflege und Verwaltung technischer Dokumentationen, Zeichnungen und Stammdaten in den entsprechenden Systemen
• Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Schnittstellen zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung von Entwicklungs- und Kundenprojekten
• Aktive Mitwirkung an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungen von Produkten, Prozessen und Konstruktionsstandards     Das bringst du mit
• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Konstrukteur EFZ oder vergleichbare technische Grundausbildung mit entsprechender Weiterbildung
• Erfahrung in der Konstruktion von technischen Produkten, idealerweise im industriellen Umfeld
• Gute Kenntnisse in CAD-Systemen (z. B. Creo, Inventor, SolidWorks oder vergleichbar) sowie im Umgang mit ERP- und PLM-Systemen
• Strukturierte, analytische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis
• Teamfähigkeit, Kommunikationsstärke und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift     Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy gestalten wir die Energiezukunft aktiv mit. Unsere Technologien ermöglichen eine zuverlässige, nachhaltige und effiziente Energieversorgung weltweit. Wir bieten dir ein innovatives Arbeitsumfeld, attraktive Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und eine Unternehmenskultur, die von Zusammenarbeit, Vielfalt und kontinuierlichem Lernen geprägt ist. Werde Teil eines Teams, das mit seinen Lösungen einen echten Beitrag zur Energiewende leistet.

• Studi di fattibilità, calcoli tecnici e analisi di tolleranza

• Cooperazione con interfacce interne ed esterne per la riuscita realizzazione di progetti di sviluppo e di clienti
• Partecipazione attiva al miglioramento continuo di prodotti, processi e standard di progettazione Lo porti con te.
• Formazione completa come costruttore EFZ o formazione tecnica di base comparabile con corrispondente ulteriore formazione
• Esperienza nella progettazione di prodotti tecnici, idealmente nell'ambiente industriale

• Lavoro di squadra, forza di comunicazione e divertimento di lavoro con diverse aree specializzate
• Conoscenza molto buona del tedesco e buona conoscenza dell'inglese in parole e scrittura Più su di noi A Hitachi Energy formuliamo attivamente il futuro dell'energia. Le nostre tecnologie consentono un approvvigionamento energetico affidabile, sostenibile ed efficiente in tutto il mondo. Entra a far parte di un team che dà un contributo reale alla transizione energetica con le sue soluzioni.
descriptionByLocale.en:
In our plant in Zurich Örlikon you develop and design innovative products and components for the energy transmission of the future. In this role, you work closely with engineering, production, purchasing and project management and accompany technical solutions from the concept phase to successful implementation. With your technical know-how and creativity, you make an important contribution to the quality, efficiency and further development of our products. You can do that.
• Creating and maintaining 3D models, assemblies, production drawings and parts lists for products and components
• Develop, design and optimize technical solutions taking into account quality, cost, deadlines and manufacturability
• Technical support for production, purchasing, quality and project management in constructive issues
• Performing feasibility studies, technical calculations and tolerance analyses
• Cooperation in product adaptations, new developments and the standardization of components and assemblies
• Maintenance and management of technical documentation, drawings and master data in the corresponding systems
• Cooperation with internal and external interfaces for the successful implementation of development and customer projects
• Active participation in continuous improvements of products, processes and design standards You bring that with you
• Completed training as constructor EFZ or comparable basic technical training with corresponding further training
• Experience in the design of technical products, ideally in the industrial environment
• Good knowledge in CAD systems (e.g. Creo, Inventor, SolidWorks or similar) as well as in dealing with ERP and PLM systems
• Structured, analytical and solution-oriented working method as well as a strong technical understanding
• Teamwork, communication strength and enjoyment of working with different specialist areas
• Very good knowledge of German as well as good knowledge of English in words and writing More about us At Hitachi Energy we actively shape the energy future. Our technologies enable a reliable, sustainable and efficient energy supply worldwide. We offer you an innovative working environment, attractive development opportunities and a corporate culture characterized by collaboration, diversity and continuous learning. Become part of a team that makes a real contribution to the energy transition with its solutions.

Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, market analysis, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product development. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Hitachi Energy è alla ricerca di un [Global\/Regional] Product Specialist per unire il nostro team innovativo in [location]. In questo ruolo, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nella gestione del portafoglio prodotti trasformatori, condurre analisi di mercato, e sostenere lo sviluppo di prodotti all'avanguardia. Questa posizione non solo offre la possibilità di ampliare le tue competenze e conoscenze nel settore energetico, ma offre anche l'opportunità di contribuire a soluzioni trasformative che promuovono la sostenibilità e promuovano la tua carriera in un mercato in rapida evoluzione. Condurre un'analisi approfondita del mercato per identificare le tendenze e valutare il loro impatto sul portafoglio Transformer. Fornire una nuova prospettiva sulla differenziazione di una tecnologia matura e di un prodotto nel mercato analizzando le tendenze del mercato, comprendendo le esigenze dei clienti e monitorando le azioni dei concorrenti con un approccio innovativo e creativo. Valutare i requisiti tecnici e svolgere valutazioni competitive per individuare le lacune dei prodotti e le opportunità di miglioramento. Gestire e aggiornare le specifiche tecniche per i prodotti esistenti per garantire la competitività e il valore del mercato. Superare le iniziative di miglioramento delle prestazioni attraverso benchmarking e feedback di qualità sui prodotti assegnati. Assicurare il rispetto delle normative internazionali e degli standard industriali in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. Sostenere lo sviluppo di nuovi prodotti traducendo i requisiti di mercato in input attuabili per la roadmap del prodotto. Preparare e presentare materiali di comunicazione tecnica per sostenere lanci di prodotto e migliorare il posizionamento di mercato. Sviluppare e fornire sessioni di formazione coinvolgenti per abilitare i team interfunzionali con le più recenti conoscenze di prodotto e approfondimenti di mercato. Responsabile per garantire il rispetto delle normative, procedure e linee guida esterne e interne applicabili. Vivere i valori fondamentali della sicurezza e dell'integrità di Hitachi Energy, il che significa assumersi la responsabilità delle proprie azioni mentre si occupano dei suoi colleghi e degli affari. La tua laurea in Ingegneria, Business Administration, Marketing o un campo relativo. Minimo di 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione dei prodotti, nell'analisi del mercato o in un ruolo simile all'interno dei trasformatori o dell'industria energetica. Forte comprensione tecnica delle soluzioni energetiche e delle tecnologie industriali per comunicare efficacemente i benefici del prodotto e differenziare le offerte. Capacità comprovata di condurre analisi di mercato e valutazioni competitive per guidare lo sviluppo del prodotto. Ottima capacità di comunicazione e presentazione sia per il pubblico tecnico che non tecnico. Capacità di lavorare in collaborazione tra team interfunzionali e gestire più progetti contemporaneamente
descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a [Global\/Regional] Product Specialist to join our innovative team in [location]. In this role, you will play a key part in managing the transformers product portfolio, conducting market analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct thorough market analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the Transformer portfolio. Provide a fresh perspective on differentiating a mature technology and product in the market by analyzing market trends, understanding customer needs, and monitoring competitors' actions with an innovative and creative approach. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on assigned products. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. Develop and deliver engaging training sessions to empower cross-functional teams with the latest product knowledge and market insights. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, market analysis, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product development. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously
descriptionByLocale.de:
Hitachi Energy sucht nach einem [Global\/Regional] Produktspezialisten, der sich unserem innovativen Team an [Standort] anschließt. In dieser Rolle spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Verwaltung des Produktportfolios von Transformatoren, der Durchführung von Marktanalysen und der Unterstützung der Entwicklung innovativer Produkte. Diese Position bietet nicht nur die Möglichkeit, Ihre Fähigkeiten und Kenntnisse in der Energiebranche zu erweitern, sondern bietet auch die Möglichkeit, zu transformativen Lösungen beizutragen, die Nachhaltigkeit fördern und Ihre Karriere in einem sich schnell entwickelnden Markt vorantreiben. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen Führen Sie eine gründliche Marktanalyse durch, um Trends zu identifizieren und ihre Auswirkungen auf das Transformer-Portfolio zu bewerten. Bieten Sie eine neue Perspektive auf die Differenzierung einer ausgereiften Technologie und eines Produkts auf dem Markt, indem Sie Markttrends analysieren, Kundenbedürfnisse verstehen und die Handlungen der Wettbewerber mit einem innovativen und kreativen Ansatz überwachen. Bewerten Sie die technischen
• Anforderungen und führen Sie Wettbewerbsbewertungen durch, um Produktlücken und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten zu ermitteln. Verwalten und aktualisieren Sie die technischen Spezifikationen für bestehende Produkte, um die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und den Wert des Marktes zu gewährleisten. Überwachung von Leistungsverbesserungsinitiativen durch Benchmarking und Qualitätsfeedback zu zugewiesenen Produkten. Gewährleistung der Einhaltung internationaler Vorschriften und Industriestandards während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus. Unterstützung der Entwicklung neuer Produkte durch die Umsetzung von Marktanforderungen in umsetzbare Inputs für die Produkt-Roadmap. Bereiten Sie technische Kommunikationsmaterialien vor, um die Einführung von Produkten zu unterstützen und die Marktpositionierung zu verbessern. Entwickeln und liefern Sie ansprechende Schulungen, um funktionsübergreifende Teams mit den neuesten Produktkenntnissen und Marktinformationen zu versorgen. Verantwortlich für die Einhaltung der geltenden externen und internen Vorschriften, Verfahren und Richtlinien. Living Hitachi Energys Kernwerte Sicherheit und Integrität, was bedeutet, Verantwortung für Ihr eigenes Handeln zu übernehmen und sich um Ihre Kollegen und das Unternehmen zu kümmern. Ihr Hintergrundstudium in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing oder einem verwandten Bereich. Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Produktmanagement, Marktanalyse oder einer ähnlichen Rolle in der Transformatoren- oder Energiebranche. Starkes technisches Verständnis von Energielösungen und Industrietechnologien, um Produktvorteile effektiv zu kommunizieren und Angebote zu differenzieren. Bewährte Fähigkeit, Marktanalysen und Wettbewerbsbewertungen durchzuführen, um die Produktentwicklung voranzutreiben. Hervorragende Kommunikation und Präsentation Fähigkeiten für technische und nicht-technische Publikum. Fähigkeit, funktionsübergreifend zusammenzuarbeiten und mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu verwalten
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'occasion Hitachi Energy est à la recherche d'un spécialiste des produits [mondial\/régional] pour rejoindre notre équipe innovante dans [localisation]. Dans ce rôle, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la gestion du portefeuille de produits des transformateurs, la conduite d'analyses de marché et le soutien au développement de produits de pointe. Ce poste permet non seulement d'élargir vos compétences et vos connaissances dans le secteur de l'énergie, mais aussi de contribuer à des solutions de transformation qui favorisent la durabilité et font progresser votre carrière dans un marché en évolution rapide. Comment vous ferez un impact Effectuez une analyse de marché approfondie pour identifier les tendances et évaluer leur impact sur le portefeuille Transformer. Fournir une nouvelle perspective sur la différenciation d'une technologie et d'un produit matures sur le marché en analysant les tendances du marché, en comprenant les besoins des clients et en surveillant les actions des concurrents avec une approche novatrice et créative. Évaluer les exigences techniques et effectuer des évaluations concurrentielles pour cerner les lacunes et les possibilités d'amélioration des produits. Gérer et mettre à jour les spécifications techniques pour les produits existants afin d'assurer la compétitivité et la valeur du marché. Superviser les initiatives d'amélioration du rendement au moyen d'analyse comparative et de rétroaction sur la qualité des produits attribués. Assurer la conformité aux règlements internationaux et aux normes de l'industrie tout au long du cycle de vie des produits. Soutenir le développement de nouveaux produits en transformant les exigences du marché en intrants concrets pour la feuille de route des produits. Préparer et présenter du matériel de communication technique pour soutenir les lancements de produits et améliorer le positionnement du marché. Concevoir et offrir des séances de formation stimulantes afin d'habiliter les équipes interfonctionnelles à acquérir les connaissances les plus récentes sur les produits et les perspectives du marché. Responsabilité d'assurer le respect des règlements, procédures et lignes directrices externes et internes applicables. Vivre les valeurs fondamentales de Hitachi Energy en matière de sécurité et d'intégrité, ce qui signifie prendre la responsabilité de vos propres actions tout en prenant soin de vos collègues et de l'entreprise. Diplôme d'ingénieur, d'administration des affaires, de marketing ou d'un domaine connexe. Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans la gestion des produits, l'analyse de marché ou un rôle similaire au sein des transformateurs ou de l'industrie de l'énergie. Une bonne compréhension technique des solutions énergétiques et des technologies industrielles pour communiquer efficacement les avantages des produits et différencier les offres. Capacité éprouvée d'effectuer des analyses de marché et des évaluations concurrentielles pour stimuler le développement de produits. Excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation pour les publics techniques et non techniques. Capacité de travailler en collaboration entre les équipes interfonctionnelles et de gérer simultanément plusieurs projets

jobs.title: Mechanical Designer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The Opportunity  Kick-start your career in mechanical design with us! We are looking for a Mechanical Designer who is eager to get involved in exciting projects and learn from experienced professionals. In this role, you will develop your skills in transformer design, working closely with our engineering team to deliver innovative solutions. If you are passionate about engineering, motivated to learn, and committed to quality, this opportunity is for you. How you'll make an impact  Design Support: Assist in developing mechanical designs by applying engineering standards and ensuring accuracy in project specifications  Collaboration: Work closely with senior engineers to contribute to solutions tailored to customer and market needs  Manufacturing Support: Provide technical support to manufacturing sites, helping ensure designs meet required specifications  Project Involvement: Support testing, installation, and commissioning activities under the guidance of experienced engineers  Problem Solving: Assist in identifying and analyzing design or product-related issues, contributing to continuous improvement  Your background  Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field  Around one year of experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in transformers or a similar industry  CAD Skills: Proficiency in CAD tools; knowledge of Creo, AutoCAD, and Windchill is an advantage  Ability to read and interpret technical (including electrical) diagrams  Fluency in Italian and English More about us   O ur flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

In questo ruolo, svilupperai le tue competenze nel design dei trasformatori, lavorando a stretto contatto con il nostro team di ingegneri per fornire soluzioni innovative. Se siete appassionati di ingegneria, motivati ad imparare e impegnati nella qualità, questa opportunità è per voi. descriptionByLocale.fr: The Opportunity Commencez votre carrière en design mécanique avec nous! Nous sommes à la recherche d'un concepteur mécanique qui est impatient de s'impliquer dans des projets passionnants et d'apprendre de professionnels expérimentés. Dans ce rôle, vous développerez vos compétences dans la conception de transformateurs, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec notre équipe d'ingénierie pour fournir des solutions innovantes. Si vous êtes passionné par l'ingénierie, motivé à apprendre et engagé à la qualité, cette opportunité est pour vous. Aide à la conception : Aider à développer des conceptions mécaniques en appliquant des normes d'ingénierie et en assurant l'exactitude des spécifications du projet Collaboration : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec des ingénieurs chevronnés pour contribuer à des solutions adaptées aux besoins de la clientèle et du marché Soutien à la fabrication : Fournir un soutien technique aux sites de fabrication, aider à assurer que les conceptions répondent aux spécifications requises Participation au projet : Soutenir les essais, l'installation et les activités de mise en service sous la direction d'ingénieurs expérimentés Résolution de problèmes : Aider à identifier et à analyser la conception ou les problèmes liés aux produits, contribuer à l'amélioration continue Vos antécédents Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie mécanique ou dans un domaine connexe Environ un an d'expérience en génie mécanique, de préférence dans les transformateurs ou dans une industrie similaire Compétences en CAO : Compétences en outils CAO; connaissance de Creo, AutoCAD et Windchill est un avantage Capacité de lire et d'interpréter des diagrammes techniques (y compris électriques) Fluence en italien et en anglais Plus sur nous O ur pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser les performances personnelles et commerciales tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et croître.

jobs.description:

Gemeinsam mit deinem Team stellst du sicher, dass die Fertigung reibungslos läuft und unsere hohen Standards in Bezug auf Sicherheit, Qualität und Effizienz jederzeit erfüllt werden.    Das kannst du bewirken Giessen von Durchführungen sowie Einformen und Auspacken von Wickelkörpern Bedienen und Überwachen der Giessharzanlage inklusive Vor- und Nachbereitung Dokumentieren von Produktions- und Prozesswerten Beheben kleiner Störungen sowie Mitwirken bei Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten Durchführen von Qualitätskontrollen an gefertigten Produkten Einhalten aller Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Umweltvorschriften Aktive Mitarbeit an Verbesserungen von Prozessen und Abläufen Das bringst du mit Ausgeprägtes Sicherheits- und Qualitätsbewusstsein Technisches Grundverständnis und Interesse an Produktionsprozessen Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung oder Weiterbildung (z. descriptionByLocale.it:
Come operatore di macchine (f\/m\/d) siete un membro prezioso della nostra produzione e contribuire direttamente alla qualità dei nostri prodotti con la vostra comprensione tecnica e il vostro metodo di lavoro attento. Insieme al vostro team, vi assicurerete che la produzione funzioni senza intoppi e i nostri elevati standard di sicurezza, qualità ed efficienza sono sempre soddisfatti. È possibile raggiungere questo obiettivo colando boccole e stampando e disimballaggio di corpi di ferita Funzionamento e monitoraggio dell'impianto di fusione in resina tra cui preparazione e follow-up Documentazione dei valori di produzione e di processo Risolvere piccoli difetti, nonché partecipare a lavori di manutenzione e manutenzione Attuazione dei controlli di qualità sui prodotti fabbricati Rispetto a tutte le normative di sicurezza, qualità e ambientale Cooperazione attiva per il miglioramento dei processi e processi. Questo ti porta con una marcata sicurezza e consapevolezza della qualità La comprensione e l'interesse di base tecnico nei processi di produzione Formazione tecnica completa o ulteriore formazione (ad esempio operatore di impianti) di vantaggio La disponibilità a lavorare nel funzionamento a 3 turni Buona conoscenza del tedesco (almeno B1) Esperienza nel trattare con drawbar, gru o piattaforma di sollevamento di vantaggio Più su di noi
• Compiti con opportunità di sviluppo Un ambiente di lavoro collegiale con comunicazione aperta Vantaggi sociali attraenti e condizioni di lavoro moderne
descriptionByLocale.en:
As a machine operator (f\/m\/d) you are a valuable member of our production and contribute directly to the quality of our products with your technical understanding and your careful working method. Together with your team, you will ensure that production runs smoothly and our high standards of safety, quality and efficiency are met at all times. You can achieve this by casting bushings as well as molding and unpacking of wound bodies Operation and monitoring of the casting resin plant including preparation and follow-up Documentation of production and process values Resolving small faults as well as participating in maintenance and maintenance work Implementation of quality controls on manufactured products Compliance with all safety, quality and environmental regulations Active cooperation on improvements of processes and processes. This brings you with pronounced safety and quality awareness Technical basic understanding and interest in production processes Completed technical training or further education (e.g. plant operator) of advantage Readiness to work in 3-shift operation Good knowledge of German (at least B1) Experience in dealing with drawbar, crane or lifting platform of advantage More about us Secure workplace in a future-oriented company
• Tasks with development opportunities A collegial working environment with open communication Attractive social benefits and modern working conditions

jobs.description:
The opportunity You will work closely with R&D Engineers to enhance test capabilities and knowledge about performances and reliability of SiC devices fabricated at Hitachi Energy. He\/She will gain exposure to testing hardware, characterization methodologies and will be involved both in conceptual and hands-on lab work. Particularly the lab work will provide to the student a comprehensive background about R&D activities within a leading semiconductor company. How you'll make an impact SiC device testing both at wafer or package level Implementation of new test methodologies for SiC devices Design and\/or improvements of existing testing hardware and software ( e.g. PCBs, DAQs, data analysis scripts) Data analysis to quantify device performance and reliability, including high volume data Prepare documentation and reports for R&D colleagues Your background Currently pursuing a Master Degree in Electronic, Electrical and Mechanical Engineering or Applied Physics Basic knowledge of hardware development and integration ( e.g. data acquisition, PCBs, etc..) Basic knowledge or interest in semiconductor device physics, power devices, particularly SiC knowledge would be a big plus Basic knowledge of statistical methods for data analysis and software such as Minitab or Python Good communication and presentation skills in English More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: Tendering Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity At Hitachi Energy our purpose is advancing a sustainable​ energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals and factories. You will join a collaborative and diverse team shaping innovative transformer solutions. As a Tendering Engineer you create preliminary design cost estimations for dry type transformers plus inductors according to customer specifications. A secondary objective is to provide sales and customers with technical support and act as a link between sales and engineering.   
• Your responsibilities Review customer specifications to define technical tender requirements Develop deviation sheets and propose suitable technical solutions Create accurate cost estimates and define material requirements in ERP and define material requirements Obtain accurate pricing information by collaborating with suppliers & vendors Ensure on-time cost estimate submittal to the bid and proposal team Maintaining accurate technical and costing product information throughout the entire deal lifecycle Provide technical tender support during bid revision or negotiation Ensure clear and timely communication with all tender stakeholders Your background University Degree in Electrical or Mechanical engineering First experience in a similar role, especially in regard to the technical skills Experience in CAD and Microsoft 365 tools Strong attention to detail and communication skills as well as a self-starter mentality Fluent in English, Italian would be beneficial Willingness to travel up to 10% More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.description: The opportunity Within Hitachi Energy's Grid Automation business, we are shaping the future of power transmission and distribution. In our automation and communication service department, based in Baden, we deliver advanced solutions with the highest standards of reliability and innovation in the field of substation automation, protection and communication. We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to take ownership of projects and service agreements in a global, matrix organization. You will coordinate cross-functional teams, act as a key interface to local and international customers and drive successful project delivery while contributing to continuous improvement and long-term value creation. How you'll make an impact Lead the end-to-end execution of local and international service projects and agreements from commercial handover to successful closure, ensuring delivery against scope, timeline, quality, and financial targets Act as the primary interface to customers, building trusted relationships and leading high-impact engagements, including technical discussions and service delivery Drive proactive risk and opportunity management, applying a strategic mindset to ensure sustainable project outcomes Maintain full accountability for project and contract performance, including financial steering, resource planning, and forecasting in close alignment with controlling and operations Lead contract execution, including change and claim management, safeguarding both customer satisfaction and business interests Foster cross-functional collaboration and alignment across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, commissioning and technical support teams in a global setup Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and actively shape best practices within the project management function Your background Proven track record (5+ years) managing complex projects and\/or service agreements in an industrial or technology-driven environment, ideally with international exposure Demonstrated ability to lead stakeholders at multiple levels, including senior customer representatives Strong commercial acumen with solid expertise in financial steering, risk management, and contract execution Confident communicator with the ability to influence, negotiate, and present effectively in an international context Experience working in matrix organizations and leading cross-cultural teams Relevant project management certifications (e.g., PMP, IPMA) are an advantage Fluent in German or French; business fluent in English is mandatory More about us   We are a flexible team with flat structures that operates in a dynamic, project‑oriented environment. Our SLAs and service projects span the full spectrum, from simple to highly complex. We value a hands‑on mentality, strong customer orientation, and a genuine willingness to invest in personal learning and growth. Thanks to our flexible working models, we can accommodate both personal and business needs while creating an environment in which all employees are empowered to perform at their best and continue to develop.

jobs.title: Operator 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position Hitachi Energy sucht Mitarbeitende (w\/m\/d) für die Bedienung von Anlagen in der Produktion. Sie unterstützen die Bereiche Produktion, Qualität und Instandhaltung bei der Herstellung von Leistungshalbleitern. In dieser Rolle bist du für die Bedienung von Maschinen und Anlagen, die Überwachung und Optimierung von Produktionsprozessen, die Durchführung von Qualitätskontrollen sowie die Unterstützung bei Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen verantwortlich. Darüber hinaus stellst du die Einhaltung von Qualitätsstandards, Effizienzvorgaben und Arbeitssicherheitsrichtlinien sicher und trägst zu einem reibungslosen Produktionsablauf bei. Das kannst du bewirken  Bedienung und Überwachung verschiedener Maschinen und Anlagen gemäß den geltenden Arbeitsanweisungen sowie Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Produktionsablaufs Durchführung regelmäßiger Kontrollen, Inspektionen und Einstellungen zur Gewährleistung einer optimalen Anlagenleistung und Produktqualität Be- und Entladen von Materialien und Produkten sowie Verwaltung von Beständen und Dokumentation relevanter Produktionsdaten Eigenständiges Erkennen und Beheben kleinerer Störungen an Maschinen und Anlagen sowie Weiterleitung größerer technischer Probleme an die zuständigen Fachbereiche Einhaltung von Sicherheitsvorschriften, Qualitätsstandards und Unternehmensrichtlinien sowie Sicherstellung von Sauberkeit und Ordnung im Arbeitsbereich Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team zur Erreichung der Produktionsziele, kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Prozessen und sorgfältigen Erstellung der erforderlichen Produktionsdokumentation Das bringst du mit  Abgeschlossene Schulbildung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation Berufserfahrung im Produktions- oder Fertigungsumfeld ist von Vorteil, idealerweise in der Halbleiterindustrie Fähigkeit, schriftliche und mündliche Arbeitsanweisungen präzise umzusetzen sowie technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen Hohe Qualitätsorientierung, sorgfältige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise, ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz sowie die Fähigkeit, sowohl selbstständig als auch im Team erfolgreich zu arbeiten Körperliche Belastbarkeit sowie Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit, einschließlich Nacht- und Wochenendschichten, verbunden mit einem hohen Sicherheitsbewusstsein und der konsequenten Einhaltung aller Arbeitsschutzvorschriften Mehr über uns Dich erwartet ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen mit abwechslungsreichen 
• Aufgaben und vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Freue dich auf ein kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit offener Kommunikation, modernen Arbeitsbedingungen und attraktiven Sozialleistungen.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Through the position Hitachi Energy, employees (f\/m\/d) are looking for the operation of plants in production. They support production, quality and maintenance in the production of power semiconductors. In this role, you are responsible for the operation of machinery and equipment, the monitoring and optimization of production processes, the implementation of quality controls and support for maintenance and maintenance measures. In addition, you ensure compliance with quality standards, efficiency requirements and occupational safety guidelines and contribute to a smooth production process. You can do this by operating and monitoring various machines and plants in accordance with the applicable work instructions as well as ensuring a smooth production process Implementation of regular controls, inspections and settings to ensure optimal plant performance and product quality loading and unloading of materials and products as well as management of stocks and documentation of relevant production data Independently detecting and resolving minor faults on machines and plants as well as transferring major technical problems to the relevant specialist areas compliance with safety regulations, quality standards and company guidelines as well as ensuring cleanliness and order in the work area Close cooperation with the team to achieve production goals, continuous improvement of processes and careful preparation of the necessary production documentation This brings you with completed school education or a comparable qualification professional experience in the production or manufacturing environment is an advantage, ideally in the semiconductor industry ability to implement written and oral work instructions precisely as well as to understand technical contexts High quality orientation, careful and reliable working methods, pronounced problem-solving skills as well as the ability to work successfully both independently and in a team Physical resilience and willingness to work shifts, including night and weekend shifts, combined with a high safety awareness and consistent compliance with all occupational safety regulations.
• Tasks and diverse development opportunities. Look forward to a collegial working environment with open communication, modern working conditions and attractive social benefits.

jobs.title: Demand Planner 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Join our team in Zurich Altstetten as a Demand Planner and take the next step in your supply chain career. In this role, you will further develop your expertise in demand forecasting, data analysis, and S&OP processes while working closely with experienced colleagues across functions. You will play an active role in translating data into actionable insights, improving forecast accuracy, and supporting efficient production planning. This is an excellent opportunity for professionals with initial experience who are eager to grow, take ownership, and make a tangible impact in an international environment. How you'll make an impact Develop, collect, maintain, and continuously improve short-, mid-, and long-term demand forecasts Assess accuracy of available information (such as forecast from sales, backlog visibility) to verify their potential usage for forecasting Development to integrate customer demand, project pipelines, and market trends into forecasts Lead and monitor the implementation of Frame Agreements with customers Lead and oversee the implementation and monitoring of price variation clauses. Track orders and proactively inform customers of any price adjustments. Analyze forecast accuracy and implement corrective actions to improve forecast performance Translate the demand forecast into future production load to provide graph visibility for the S&OP forums Be involved in new product introductions, phase-ins, and phase-outs by providing demand projections and scenario analyses Develop and maintain the necessary KPIs Your background Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, Economics, or a related field Minimum 3 years of experience in demand planning, forecasting, or supply chain planning (experience in industrial, energy, or manufacturing environments preferred) Strong analytical skills Advanced Excel skills; experience with Power BI or other analytics tools is a plus Proficiency in ERP and planning systems (SAP, SAP IBP\/APO, or similar) Knowledge of S&OP \/ IBP best practices Strong communication and stakeholder management skills English required, German is a plus More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti al nostro team di Zurigo Altstetten come Demand Planner e fai il passo successivo nella tua carriera nella supply chain. In questo ruolo, svilupperai ulteriormente le tue competenze nella previsione della domanda, nell'analisi dei dati e nei processi S&OP, lavorando a stretto contatto con colleghi esperti in tutte le funzioni. Si svolgerà un ruolo attivo nel tradurre i dati in insight attuabili, migliorare la precisione delle previsioni e sostenere una pianificazione efficiente della produzione. Questa è un'ottima opportunità per i professionisti con esperienza iniziale che sono desiderosi di crescere, prendere la proprietà e fare un impatto tangibile in un ambiente internazionale. Sviluppare, raccogliere, mantenere e migliorare continuamente le previsioni di domanda a breve, a metà e a lungo termine Valutare l'accuratezza delle informazioni disponibili (come le previsioni di vendita, visibilità backlog) per verificare il loro potenziale utilizzo per la previsione Sviluppo per integrare la domanda del cliente, le pipeline di progetto e le tendenze del mercato nelle previsioni Piombo e monitorare l'implementazione di Frame Agreement con i clienti Piombo e supervisionare l'implementazione e il monitoraggio delle clausole di variazione dei prezzi. Tracciare gli ordini e informare proattivamente i clienti di eventuali regolazioni di prezzo. Analizzare l'accuratezza delle previsioni e implementare azioni correttive per migliorare le prestazioni previsionali Tradurre le previsioni della domanda nel futuro carico di produzione per fornire visibilità dei grafici per i forum S&OP Essere coinvolti in nuove introduzioni di prodotto, phase-ins e phase-out fornendo proiezioni di domanda e analisi di scenario Sviluppare e mantenere i KPI necessari Il tuo corso di laurea in Gestione della Supply Chain, Business, Ingegneria, Economia o un campo correlato Minimo 3 anni di esperienza nella pianificazione della domanda, previsione o pianificazione della supply chain (esperienza in ambienti industriali, energetici o di produzione preferiti) Forti competenze analitiche Competenze avanzate di Excel; l'esperienza con Power BI o altri strumenti di analisi è un plus Proficiency in ERP e sistemi di pianificazione (SAP, SAP IBP\/APO, o simili) Conoscenza delle best practice S&OP \/ IBP Forte capacità di comunicazione e di gestione degli stakeholder richiesto, il tedesco è un plus Più su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali, creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

In dieser Funktion entwickeln Sie Ihre Expertise in den Bereichen Bedarfsprognose, Datenanalyse und S&OP-Prozesse weiter und arbeiten eng mit erfahrenen Kollegen in allen Funktionen zusammen. jobs.title: Production Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity  Our local Insulation & Components product group is the technical market leader in the development and manufacture of transformer bushings. We work with renowned international companies in the fields of energy generation, transmission, and distribution. Our high-voltage bushings are among the best in the world. As a production engineer, you will play a key role in increasing operational efficiency, ensuring the highest quality standards, and leading groundbreaking projects that will shape the future of our production.  How you'll make an impact  Ensuring maximum plant availability through close cooperation with maintenance and suppliers  Leading projects to optimize throughput times and reduce quality-related costs  Conducting pilot studies to define optimal process parameters and promote continuous improvement  Taking the lead in commissioning new processes and equipment, including defining action plans and training for maintenance and production teams  Evaluating innovative process technologies to improve quality, productivity, and cost efficiency  Investigating process deviations and implementing effective corrective measures  You will actively contribute to the digitalization of production and increasing automation  Leading industrialization projects from planning to successful implementation  Your background  Completed technical degree (ETH\/FH) in production sciences (MTEC), electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, automation technology, or a comparable field  Solid professional experience in the mechanization and automation of production processes and systems, as well as knowledge of high-voltage technology, are an advantage  Experience in technical documentation and work planning to ensure smooth operations  Extensive knowledge in the application of quality methods and tools (e.g., 8D, Ishikawa, moderation techniques)  Very good German language skills (spoken and written) and English language skills at C1 level to operate in an international environment  Confident manner and strong communication and leadership skills to motivate and inspire teams  More about us  We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer dedicated mentorship and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

jobs.title: Senior Expert in Energy System Modelling and Advanced Power System Analysis
jobs.description: The Opportunity At Hitachi Energy, you help define how future power systems will be planned, built, and operated. As Senior Expert in Energy System Modelling and Advanced Power System Analysis, you play a key role in shaping the company's perspective on the global energy transition. Within the Market Innovation function and the Power Systems of the Future research program, you lead complex analytical work at the intersection of long‑term system planning, market design, and detailed technical grid analysis. You translate disruptive trends such as, renewables, electrification, sector coupling, inverter‑based resources into robust scenarios, advanced models, and actionable insights. This role is designed for a highly experienced technical professional who combines deep analytical expertise with strategic thinking, software proficiency, and the ability to influence peers, stakeholders, and future technology directions. How you'll make an impact Lead development of medium‑ and long‑term energy transition scenarios Analyze impacts of electrification, hydrogen, storage, and market design Translate policy, technology, and climate drivers into modeling assumptions Advance capacity expansion and system planning methodologies and tools Improve optimization formulations, algorithms, and computational workflows Perform advanced power system studies, including dynamics and fault analysis Assess integration of inverter‑based resources and grid‑forming controls Bridge strategic planning models with detailed technical network studies Your background PhD in Electrical Engineering, Energy Systems, Computer Science, or similar; or MSc with 3+ years of relevant professional experience Deep expertise in energy system modeling and scenario analysis Strong knowledge of mathematical optimization and advanced simulations Proven experience with steady‑state, dynamic, and short‑circuit studies Solid understanding of converter‑dominated and inverter‑based resources Advanced programming skills in Python and MATLAB\/Simulink Hands‑on experience with tools such as PowerFactory, PSS®E, or PSCAD Ability to mentor others and contribute to technical leadership More About Us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Come Senior Expert in Energy System Modelling e Advanced Power System Analysis, si gioca un ruolo chiave nella definizione della prospettiva dell'azienda sulla transizione energetica globale. All'interno della funzione Market Innovation e dei Power Systems del programma di ricerca Future, si conduce un lavoro analitico complesso all'intersezione di pianificazione del sistema a lungo termine, progettazione del mercato e analisi della griglia tecnica dettagliata. Questo ruolo è stato progettato per un professionista tecnico altamente esperto che combina competenze analitiche profonde con il pensiero strategico, la competenza del software, e la capacità di influenzare peers, stakeholders e future direzioni tecnologiche. Mansioni - Sviluppo dei requisiti degli scenari di transizione energetica a medio e lungo termine - Analizzare gli impatti dell'elettrificazione, dell'idrogeno, dello stoccaggio e del design del mercato - Tradurre la politica, la tecnologia e i driver climatici nelle ipotesi di modellazione - Analisi di espansione della capacità avanzata e metodi di pianificazione del sistema flessibili - Migliorare le formulazioni di ottimizzazione, gli algoritmi e i flussi di lavoro computazionali.

jobs.title: HSE Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about creating a safe and sustainable working environment where people can thrive? As our HSE Manager for PSC Switzerland, you will take full ownership of the Health, Safety, and Environment function and play a key role in shaping a strong safety culture across our organization. In this position, you will lead and develop the HSE team while acting as the Site Lead Manager (HSE) for our Training Center in Rüti and Service Logistic Center in Dietlikon. You will collaborate closely with leadership, employees, and external partners to ensure the highest health and safety standards, drive continuous improvement, and make a tangible impact on how we protect our people and operations every day. How you'll make an impact Lead HSE function and team for PSC Switzerland and serve as Site Lead Manager (HSE) for Training Center in Rüti and Service Logistic Center in Dietlikon  Ensure strong commitment to health and safety standards, guidelines, management systems, and procedures  Communicate health and safety initiatives, processes, and procedures to ensure uniform understanding across the organization  Monitor compliance with health and safety requirements and handle non-conformances according to established procedures  Assist and guide management, supervisors, and employees in accident prevention and act as an interface with contractors and clients when needed  Implement and maintain the health and safety management system and ensure quality input where necessary  Conduct safety audits, investigate accidents, identify root causes, and supervise corrective actions  Provide guidance on competency-based health and safety training and lead HSE and Sustainability Reviews for Rüti and Dietlikon, ensuring assurance activities are completed  Your background 5+ years of experience in managerial role in industrial company, preferably in HSE, construction or factory environment  Strong leadership personality and excellent interpersonal and communication skills  Understanding of health and safety in project\/customer sites and the role a safety system plays in managing the overall risk profile of a site  Practical “hands-on” experience in developing and managing safety systems with the ability to dig into site-specific details and develop solutions to complex safety issues  Knowledge about OSHA legislation for construction sites and working experience in Safety-related positions  International experience and intercultural sensitivity and Solutions-oriented personality with strong engagement  Proficiency in English (written and oral), German of advantage and any other language is a plus  Approximately 25% Travel required More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.
