descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance: Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, ein sicheres und nachhaltiges Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem sich Menschen entfalten können? Als unser HSE-Manager für PSC Schweiz übernehmen Sie die volle Verantwortung für die Funktion Gesundheit, Sicherheit und Umwelt und spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung einer starken Sicherheitskultur in unserer gesamten Organisation. In dieser Position leiten und entwickeln Sie das HSE-Team und fungieren gleichzeitig als Site Lead Manager (HSE) für unser Schulungszentrum in Rüti und das Service Logistic Center in Dietlikon. Sie arbeiten eng mit Führungskräften, Mitarbeitern und externen Partnern zusammen, um höchste Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsstandards zu gewährleisten, kontinuierliche Verbesserungen voranzutreiben und spürbare Auswirkungen darauf zu haben, wie wir unsere Mitarbeiter und Betriebe jeden Tag schützen. So können Sie etwas bewirken: Leiten Sie die HSE-Funktion und das HSE-Team für PSC Schweiz und fungieren Sie als Site Lead Manager (HSE) für das Schulungszentrum in Rüti und das Service-Logistikzentrum in Dietlikon. Sorgen Sie für ein starkes Engagement für Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsstandards, Richtlinien, Managementsysteme und Verfahren. Kommunizieren Sie Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsinitiativen, -prozesse und -verfahren, um ein einheitliches Verständnis in der gesamten Organisation zu gewährleisten. Überwachen Sie die Einhaltung von Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsanforderungen und behandeln Sie Nichtkonformitäten gemäß festgelegten Verfahren. Unterstützen und leiten Sie Management, Vorgesetzte und Mitarbeiter bei der Unfallverhütung und fungieren Sie als Schnittstelle bei Bedarf mit Auftragnehmern und Kunden zusammenarbeiten. Implementieren und pflegen Sie das Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsmanagementsystem und stellen Sie bei Bedarf Qualitätseingaben sicher. Führen Sie Sicherheitsaudits durch, untersuchen Sie Unfälle, identifizieren Sie Grundursachen und überwachen Sie Korrekturmaßnahmen. Bieten Sie Anleitung zu kompetenzbasierten Gesundheits- und Sicherheitsschulungen und leiten Sie HSE- und Nachhaltigkeitsprüfungen für Rüti und Dietlikon, um sicherzustellen, dass die Sicherungsaktivitäten abgeschlossen werden. Ihr Hintergrund. Mehr als 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Führungspositionen in einem Industrieunternehmen, vorzugsweise im HSE-, Bau- oder Fabrikumfeld. Starke Führungspersönlichkeit und ausgezeichnete zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten. Verständnis für Gesundheit und Sicherheit an Projekt-/Kundenstandorten und die Rolle, die ein Sicherheitssystem bei der Verwaltung des Gesamtrisikoprofils eines Standorts spielt. Praktische „praktische“ Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Verwaltung von Sicherheitssystemen mit der Fähigkeit, sich mit standortspezifischen Details zu befassen und Lösungen für komplexe Sicherheitsprobleme zu entwickeln. Kenntnisse über die OSHA-Gesetzgebung für Baustellen und Berufserfahrung in sicherheitsbezogenen Positionen. Internationale Erfahrung und interkulturelle Sensibilität sowie lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit starkem Engagement. Kenntnisse in Englisch (schriftlich und mündlich), Deutsch von Vorteil und jeder anderen Sprache sind von Vorteil. Ungefähr 25 % Reiseaufwand. Mehr darüber Uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione L'occasione Hitachi Energy, prodotti ad alta tensione, è rinomata in tutto il mondo come specialista per la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia. La nostra unità Gas isolato Switchgears (GIS), con sede a Zürich-Oerlikon, è attiva nello sviluppo e nella produzione di sistemi di commutazione isolata a gas. Garantiamo l'elevata affidabilità dei nostri sistemi utilizzando strumenti e metodi di sviluppo all'avanguardia. Come Area Sales Manager, prenderete la proprietà di guidare la crescita aziendale all'interno della vostra regione assegnata e plasmare attivamente il nostro successo di mercato. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con clienti e partner, posizionando il nostro portafoglio all'avanguardia e fornendo soluzioni che soddisfano requisiti tecnici e commerciali complessi. Entrando nel nostro team internazionale e altamente esperto, si acquisirà approfondimenti nel business ad alta tensione, contribuendo direttamente ai sistemi energetici sostenibili e affidabili. Questo ruolo offre un'opportunità unica per coniugare competenze tecniche con responsabilità commerciale e per dare un impatto tangibile sul futuro dell'energia. Come farai ad avere un impatto - Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie di vendita per la tua regione assegnata, guidare la crescita sostenibile del business e aumentare la quota di mercato all'interno del portafoglio GIS - Costruire, mantenere ed espandere relazioni forti con i clienti chiave, gli EPC e i partner per identificare le opportunità di business e creare valore a lungo termine - Prendere la proprietà del ciclo di vendita completo, dall'identificazione delle opportunità e offrire la preparazione alla negoziazione e la chiusura di accordi di successo - Collaborare a stretto contatto con le parti interessate interne come l'ingegneria, la gestione del progetto e i team di assistenza per fornire soluzioni competitive e orientate al cliente - Analizzare le tendenze del mercato, le esigenze dei clienti e le attività concorrenti per posizionare in modo proattivo il nostro portafoglio e rafforzare la nostra presenza di mercato - Incremento dell'ordine e crescita dei ricavi, garantendo al contempo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali e le priorità strategiche - Sostenere i clienti in tutto il ciclo di vita dei progetti, assicurando un alto livello di soddisfazione e individuando opportunità per ulteriori affari Il tuo sfondo - Minimo 5 anni di esperienza professionale nelle vendite tecniche, gestione del conto chiave, o un ruolo simile rispetto al cliente, idealmente all'interno del settore energetico o industriale - Laurea (Bachelor o Master) in ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica, o un campo tecnico correlato, completato da una forte comprensione commerciale - Provato track record nella vendita di prodotti o sistemi tecnici complessi, con la capacità di gestire il ciclo di vendita completo e chiudere con successo le offerte - Esperienza di lavoro con i clienti attraverso diversi livelli e funzioni, tra cui la capacità di costruire la fiducia, influenzare le decisioni e gestire i negoziati impegnativi - una forte comprensione del mercato dell'energia, dell'industria manifatturiera o del business del sistema, idealmente con l'esposizione a sottostazioni o tecnologie di commutazione - Mindset Entrepreneurial con un approccio proattivo e orientato alla soluzione, combinato con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e guidare argomenti in avanti - Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e presentazione, con una mentalità collaborativa e la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team internazionali e interfunzionali - Volontà al viaggio (circa il 20%) Ulteriori informazioni su di noi - Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione L'opportunité Hitachi Energy, produits haute tension, est reconnue dans le monde entier comme un spécialiste de la transmission et de la distribution de puissance. jobs.title: Technical Buyer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. The Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of generator circuit-breaker (GCB) systems and gas insulated switchgears (GIS), including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, added value services, troubleshooting, extensions, retrofits and replacements. As a Technical Buyer, you act as a key interface between Procurement, Engineering, Quality, and our global supplier network. You ensure that technically specified materials, components, and services are clearly defined, technically clarified, qualified, and available in line with project, quality, and delivery requirements. Through close cross‑functional collaboration, you translate engineering requirements into robust sourcing solutions and support supplier qualification and technical alignment. Your role contributes directly to product quality, supply reliability, and operational excellence, enabling Hitachi Energy to deliver innovative and sustainable energy solutions to our customers worldwide. How you'll make an impact Perform technical clarification of materials, drawings, specifications, and engineering changes in close collaboration with Engineering and suppliers Support and coordinate Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) activities, first samples, and supplier qualification processes Conduct technical evaluations of alternative materials, deviation requests, and obsolescence cases Collaborate closely with Strategic and Operational Buyers on supplier- and material-related topics Support the handling of supplier complaints, Non‑Conformity Reports (NCRs), and root cause analyses Support and participate in supplier assessments and technical supplier evaluations, including capability, quality, and process maturity reviews Contribute to supplier performance evaluations together with Quality and Strategic Procurement Ensure accuracy and completeness of material and supplier master data in SAP and act as the technical contact point during supplier escalations Support Service Organization and Project Teams in complex or urgent procurement topics Your background Completed technical education (e.g. Polymechanic, Automation Technician, Mechanical Technician, Design Engineer or similar) 3-5 years experience in technical procurement or SCM‑related roles Strong understanding of technical drawings, Bill of Material and manufacturing processes Experience working with suppliers on technical and quality‑related topics Structured, solution‑oriented, and communicative working style Good German skills and very good English skills SAP knowledge Proactive, structured, and solution-focused working style. Team oriented mindset with strong cross-functional collaboration More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Hitachi Energy, Prodotti ad alta tensione La nostra azienda è nota a livello mondiale come specialista per la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia. L'unità di Servizio è responsabile del supporto post-vendita a livello mondiale per i sistemi di circuito-breaker per generatori (GCB) e per le sostanze di commutazione isolate con gas (GIS), compresi la formazione, l'installazione e la commissione, la manutenzione programmata, i servizi di valore aggiunto, la risoluzione dei problemi, gli estensioni, i retrofit e le sostituzioni. Descrizione del ruolo Come Acquirente Tecnico, agirai come interfaccia chiave tra Procurement, Ingegneria, Qualità e la nostra rete globale di fornitori. Assicurerai che i materiali, i componenti e i servizi specificiti tecnologicimente chiaramente definiti, chiariti, qualificati e disponibili in linea con le esigenze dei progetti, della qualità e della consegna. Attraverso una stretta collaborazione interfunzionale, traduirai le esigenze di ingegneria in soluzioni di approvvigionamento robuste e supporterai la qualifica dei fornitori e l'allineamento tecnico. Il tuo ruolo diretto alla qualità dei prodotti, alla affidabilità delle forniture e all'eccellenza operativa, volendo a Hitachi Energy di fornire soluzioni innovative e sostenibili per l'energia ai nostri clienti in tutto il mondo. Come realizzare un impatto - Esegui la chiarificazione tecnica dei materiali, dei disegni, delle specifiche e delle modifiche ingegneristiche in stretta collaborazione con l'Ingegneria e i fornitori. - Supporta e coordina le attività del Processo di Approvazione dei Parti di Produzione (PPAP), le prime prove e i processi di classificazione dei fornitori. - Conduci le necessarie tecniche di materiali alternativi, richieste di deviazione e boss di obsolescenza. - Collabora diretta con gli Acquirenti Strategici e Operativi sui temi relativi ai fornitori e ai materiali. - Supporta l'organizzazione e la gestione delle lamentele dei fornitori, dei Rapporti di Non Conformità (NCR) e delle analisi di causa radice. - Supporta e partecipa alle competenze dei fornitori e alle dirette tecniche dei fornitori, comprese le recensioni della capacità, della qualità e della maturità dei processi. - Contribuisce alle prestazioni dei fornitori insieme con la Qualità e la Procurement Strategica. - Assicura l'accuratezza e la completezza dei dati di master dei materiali e dei fornitori nel SAP e agiscono come punto di contatto tecnico durante le escalazioni dei fornitori. - Supporta l'Organizzazione di Servizio e le Squadre di Progetto in materia di approvvigionamento complessivo o urgenti.
• Requisiti - Educazione tecnica completata (ad esempio Polimematico, Tecnico di Automazione, Tecnico Meccanico, Ingegnere di Progetto o simili) - 3-5 anni di esperienza in approvvigionamento tecnico o ruoli correlati allo SCM - Buona comprensione dei disegni tecnici, della Lista di Materiali e dei processi di produzione - Esperienza nel lavoro con i fornitori su temi tecnici e di qualità - Stile di lavoro strutturato, orientaleto alla soluzione e comunicativo - Buone abilità in tedesco e ottimi livelli di inglese - Conoscenza di SAP - Stile di lavoro proattivo, strutturato e orientale alla soluzione - Mindset orientaleto al team con forte collaborazione interfunzionale Cosa? - Pratiche di lavoro flessibili che ti aiuti a ottimizzare il rendimento personale e professionale e a creare un ambiente in cui tutti gli impiegati possano sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

Join a diverse global community that thrives on collaboration, innovation, and purpose. We are looking for an experienced R&D Team Lead with a strong background in power semiconductor technologies and a proven track record in leading and developing high-performing R&D teams. How you'll make an impact Lead, manage, and develop a team of R&D engineers, fostering a high-performance, collaborative, and accountable team culture Take full responsibility for team delivery, including resource planning, performance management, and team development Own the end-to-end development of bipolar semiconductor devices, from concept to manufacturing transfer Define and execute R&D strategies aligned with business goals and technology roadmaps Drive innovation in materials, device architectures, and fabrication processes Collaborate closely with process engineering, product management, and manufacturing to ensure successful industrialization Actively monitor emerging technologies and market trends in power semiconductors Guide and review technical work, ensuring high quality standards and technical excellence Oversee project execution, including timelines, budget, and risk management Prepare and review technical documentation, presentations, and patent development Extensive hands-on experience in power semiconductor devices (e.g. IGBTs, power MOSFETs, diodes, thyristors) or related applications Demonstrated ability to drive technical delivery jobs.title: Field Service Technician Power Transformers (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   Join our dynamic Transformers After Sales team in Zürich, Switzerland, and play a hands-on role in powering the nation! As a key player, you'll be at the forefront of maintaining and enhancing the reliability and longevity of power transformers all across Switzerland. In this role, you'll directly impact the stability of the Swiss electrical grid and get the unique opportunity to work alongside leading companies in the Swiss energy sector.  Every day, you'll tackle new technical challenges, ensure the safe and high-quality execution of critical fieldwork, and proudly represent Hitachi Energy's reputation for technical excellence and customer satisfaction. Step into a position where your expertise truly makes a difference!    How you´ll make an impact Apply and enforce Hitachi Energy safety standards during all onsite operations.  Perform installations, preventive and corrective maintenance, inspections, and overhauls on power transformers in accordance with internal procedures.  Plan, coordinate and optimize field interventions to ensure efficiency and quality.  Identify potential service opportunities and communicate them to the Sales team.  Collaborate closely with customers, project teams, suppliers and other stakeholders, ensuring clear and timely communication.  Actively contribute to continuous improvement within the service organization.  Complete all reports, documentation and quality records accurately in the internal tracking system.    Your background   Federal Certificate of Competence (CFC) in mechanics, industrial maintenance, electromechanics, or a related field (e.g., locksmith, mechanic, polymechanic, automation technician).  At least 2 years of relevant field experience is considered an asset.  Willingness to travel across Switzerland for extended periods (minimum 1 week) and occasionally work in 2×8 shifts.  Strong sense of responsibility and high awareness of safety requirements.  Valid Category B driver's licence.  Good command of German, with English and French as additional working languages.    What would be a plus   Knowledge of electrical wiring and electrical diagrams  Welding skills  Motivation to follow internal training on transformer assembly and field interventions, including advanced training in Hitachi Energy factories  More about us Exciting and varied responsibilities with plenty of room for autonomy and creativity Attractive opportunities for further training and personal development Interesting and diverse tasks and projects – including international assignments A well ‑ coordinated and dynamic team An open and supportive company culture An attractive compensation package including fixed salary, travel and meal allowances, as well as the opportunity to have a say in accommodation arrangements

descriptionByLocale.it: Unisciti al nostro dinamico Transformers After Sales team di Zurigo, Svizzera, e gioca un ruolo pratico nel potere della nazione! Come giocatore chiave, sarete in prima linea nel mantenere e migliorare l'affidabilità e la longevità dei trasformatori di potenza in tutta la Svizzera. In questo ruolo, influenzerai direttamente la stabilità della rete elettrica svizzera e avrai l'opportunità unica di lavorare insieme a aziende leader nel settore energetico svizzero. Ogni giorno affronterai nuove sfide tecniche, garantirai l'esecuzione sicura e di alta qualità del lavoro sul campo critico e rappresenterai con orgoglio la reputazione di Hitachi Energy per l'eccellenza tecnica e la soddisfazione del cliente. Entra in una posizione in cui la tua esperienza fa davvero la differenza! Applicare e far rispettare gli standard di sicurezza Hitachi Energy durante tutte le operazioni in loco. Eseguire installazioni, manutenzione preventiva e correttiva, ispezioni e revisioni sui trasformatori di potenza in conformità con le procedure interne. Pianificare, coordinare e ottimizzare gli interventi sul campo per garantire efficienza e qualità. Identificare potenziali opportunità di servizio e comunicarle al team Vendite. Collabora a stretto contatto con clienti, team di progetto, fornitori e altri stakeholder, garantendo una comunicazione chiara e tempestiva. Contribuire attivamente al miglioramento continuo all'interno dell'organizzazione del servizio. Completa tutti i report, la documentazione e i record di qualità esattamente nel sistema di tracciamento interno. Il vostro fondo certificato federale di competenza (CFC) in meccanica, manutenzione industriale, elettromeccanica, o un campo correlato (ad esempio, fabbro, meccanico, polimeccanico, tecnico di automazione). Almeno 2 anni di esperienza sul campo rilevante è considerato un bene. Volontà di viaggiare attraverso la Svizzera per lunghi periodi (minimo 1 settimana) e occasionalmente lavorare in 2×8 turni. Forte senso di responsabilità e alta consapevolezza dei requisiti di sicurezza. Licenza valida del conducente della categoria B. Buon comando del tedesco, con inglese e francese come lingue di lavoro aggiuntive. Conoscenza dei cablaggi elettrici e diagrammi elettrici Capacità di saldatura Motivazione per seguire la formazione interna sull'assemblaggio dei trasformatori e gli interventi sul campo, inclusa la formazione avanzata nelle fabbriche Hitachi Energy Maggiori informazioni su di noi Responsabilità emozionanti e varie con ampio spazio per autonomia e creatività Opportunità interessanti per ulteriori formazione e sviluppo personale Compiti e progetti interessanti e diversi – tra cui incarichi internazionali Un team ben coordinato e dinamico Una cultura aziendale aperta e di supporto Un pacchetto di compensazione attraente, tra cui stipendio fisso, spese di viaggio e di pasto, così come l'opportunità di avere una voce nel regime di alloggio

descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Rejoignez notre dynamique équipe Transformers After Sales à Zurich, en Suisse, et jouez un rôle pratique dans le pouvoir de la nation ! En tant que joueur clé, vous serez à l'avant-garde du maintien et de l'amélioration de la fiabilité et de la longévité des transformateurs de puissance partout en Suisse. Dans ce rôle, vous aurez un impact direct sur la stabilité du réseau électrique suisse et aurez l'occasion unique de travailler avec des entreprises de premier plan du secteur énergétique suisse. Chaque jour, vous vous attaquerez à de nouveaux défis techniques, assurerez une exécution sûre et de haute qualité des travaux critiques sur le terrain et représenterez fièrement la réputation d'Hitachi Energy pour son excellence technique et sa satisfaction de la clientèle. Entrez dans une position où votre expertise fait vraiment une différence! Comment vous ferez un impact Appliquer et appliquer les normes de sécurité de l'énergie Hitachi pendant toutes les opérations sur place. Effectuer les installations, l'entretien préventif et correctif, les inspections et les révisions des transformateurs de puissance conformément aux procédures internes. Planifier, coordonner et optimiser les interventions sur le terrain pour assurer l'efficacité et la qualité. Identifier les possibilités de service et les communiquer à l'équipe des ventes. Collaborer étroitement avec les clients, les équipes de projet, les fournisseurs et les autres intervenants, en assurant une communication claire et opportune. Contribuer activement à l'amélioration continue au sein de l'organisation de services. Remplir avec précision tous les rapports, la documentation et les dossiers de qualité dans le système de suivi interne. Vos antécédents Certificat fédéral de compétence (CFC) en mécanique, entretien industriel, électromécanique ou dans un domaine connexe (p. ex., serrurier, mécanicien, polymécanique, technicien en automatisation). Au moins deux années d'expérience sur le terrain sont considérées comme un atout. Volonté de voyager à travers la Suisse pendant de longues périodes (minimum 1 semaine) et de travailler occasionnellement en 2×8. Un fort sens des responsabilités et une grande sensibilisation aux exigences de sécurité. Permis de conduire de catégorie B valide. Bonne maîtrise de l'allemand, l'anglais et le français étant des langues de travail supplémentaires. Ce qui serait un plus Connaissance du câblage électrique et des diagrammes électriques Aptitudes au soudage Motivation à suivre une formation interne sur l'assemblage des transformateurs et les interventions sur le terrain, y compris une formation avancée dans les usines d'Hitachi Énergie Plus sur nous Des responsabilités passionnantes et variées avec beaucoup de place pour l'autonomie et la créativité Des possibilités intéressantes pour la formation continue et le développement personnel Des tâches et des projets intéressants et variés – y compris des missions internationales Une équipe bien coordonnée et dynamique Une culture d'entreprise ouverte et solidaire Un ensemble de rémunérations attrayant comprenant un salaire fixe, des indemnités de voyage et de repas, ainsi que la possibilité d'avoir voix au chapitre dans les arrangements d'hébergement

jobs.title: Process Engineer BiMOS Backend - Assembly 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated power module production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automated chip assembly and soldering. How you'll make an impact Improve the capability of chip attach processes through the application of statistical methods and design of experiments Analyse production data to enhance process performance, identify long-term trends, and support the prevention of potential failures Lead the optimization of automated production systems to improve manufacturing capacity, stability, and quality Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis activities to sustain and improve production throughput Contribute to new product development by shaping production processes and supporting the successful transition to volume manufacturing Your background A master's degree in industrial, mechanical, electrical, or chemical engineering, or a related field Several years of experience in an automated production environment Solid machine-vision and automated inspection skills, as well as experience in Pick and Place processes Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis, Six Sigma methodologies, and production statistics is a plus Proficiency in both German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.en: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated power module production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automated chip assembly and soldering. How you'll make an impact Improve the capability of chip attach processes through the application of statistical methods and design of experiments Analyse production data to enhance process performance, identify long-term trends, and support the prevention of potential failures Lead the optimization of automated production systems to improve manufacturing capacity, stability, and quality Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis activities to sustain and improve production throughput Contribute to new product development by shaping production processes and supporting the successful transition to volume manufacturing Your background A master's degree in industrial, mechanical, electrical, or chemical engineering, or a related field Several years of experience in an automated production environment Solid machine-vision and automated inspection skills, as well as experience in Pick and Place processes Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis, Six Sigma methodologies, and production statistics is a plus Proficiency in both German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Photolithography Process Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Join a high performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. As a Senior Photolithography Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. Your role will involve working with advanced lithography equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high-quality production standards. This is your opportunity to shape technical decisions, contribute to long term tool strategies, and drive meaningful improvements in stability, uptime, and process performance. Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today! How you'll make an impact Ensure processes meet the production program and yield goals and address any product yield and rework issues. Engage with equipment and material vendors to develop new solutions and improve existing processes, to ensure smooth functioning of the production line. Develop new techniques, modify existing designs, and coordinate process improvement projects. Analyze process data to identify trends, optimize performance, and troubleshoot issues (implement and regularly check SPC). Independent planning and Implementation of new machinery into the production line. Work closely with process integration, wet etch, diffusion, metals, dry etch, and implant teams to ensure seamless production. Supports some metrology tools i.e. to measure CD and Overlay. On-call duties on weekends and public holidays (as required from the production) with participation in the on-call meeting (before the on-call duty) agreed on his own responsibility with the other on-call service providers. Your background Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Materials Science or Physics) with 5+ years of experience in industry or master's degree with 3+ years of experience in industry or Ph.D. with industry experience Extensive experience in wafer photolithography operations especially in coating and exposure in Steppers, in a wafer manufacturing environment (thin-film-head, semiconductor wafer manufacturing) Familiarity with automated wafer factory software systems like SPC, MES and Experience with data extraction, manipulation, and analysis Strong understanding of optics and immersion lithography Proficiency in data science and programming is preferred Good English and German language skills Ability to work in a cleanroom environment More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Descrizione - L'opportunité Joignez-vous à une équipe de photolithographie performante où votre expertise fait vraiment un impact. - En tant qu'ingénieur principal de photolithographie, vous serez chargé de développer et d'optimiser les processus de photolithographie utilisés dans la fabrication de semi-conducteurs. - Votre rôle consistera à travailler avec des équipements de lithographie avancés, à collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et à garantir des normes de production de haute qualité. - C'est l'occasion de façonner les décisions techniques, de contribuer à des stratégies d'outils à long terme et d'améliorer significativement la stabilité, le temps d'attente et la performance des processus. - Êtes-vous quelqu'un qui prend possession, prospère dans un environnement rapide, et aime faire un impact réel? Alors appliquez aujourd'hui ! Mansioni - Baccalauréat dans un domaine connexe (p. ex., électrique, mécanique, chimique, science des matériaux ou physique) avec 5+ années d'expérience dans l'industrie ou maîtrise avec 3+ années d'expérience dans l'industrie ou doctorat avec expérience de l'industrie - Expérience approfondie dans les opérations de photolithographie des wafers, en particulier dans le revêtement et l'exposition dans les Steppers, dans un environnement de fabrication des wafers (fabrication des wafers à feuilles minces et à semi-conducteurs) - Familiarité avec les systèmes logiciels automatisés comme SPC, MES et Expérience avec l'extraction, la manipulation et l'analyse de données - Forte compréhension de l'optique et de la lithographie d'immersion - La compétence en science des données et en programmation est préférée - Bonnes compétences en anglais et en allemand - Capacité de travailler dans un environnement propre
• Requisiti - S'engager avec les fournisseurs d'équipements et de matériaux pour développer de nouvelles solutions et améliorer les processus existants, pour assurer le bon fonctionnement de la chaîne de production. - Élaborer de nouvelles techniques, modifier les conceptions existantes et coordonner les projets d'amélioration des processus. - Analyser les données du processus pour identifier les tendances, optimiser les performances et résoudre les problèmes (mise en œuvre et vérification régulière du CPS). - Planification indépendante et mise en place de nouvelles machines dans la chaîne de production. - Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'intégration des procédés, d'éther humide, de diffusion, de métaux, d'éther sec et d'implants pour assurer une production transparente. - Supporte certains outils de métrologie, c'est-à-dire pour mesurer CD et Overlay. - Les services de garde les week-ends et jours fériés (selon les besoins de la production) avec participation à la réunion de garde (avant le service de garde) ont convenu de sa propre responsabilité avec les autres prestataires de services de garde.
• Cosa offriamo - Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et professionnelle tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: Scientist - Reliability Engineering (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The Opportunity Empower the Future with Hitachi Energy! Join us as a Scientist in Reliability Engineering and become part of a passionate, dynamic, and innovative team driving the energy transition. We are seeking a skilled and motivated scientist to strengthen our research in the reliability of power grid components and systems. In this role, you will bridge theory and application—developing and validating cutting-edge methods and technologies that support a more sustainable energy future.   How you'll make an impact Drive innovation in reliability analysis, reliability improvement, and prognostics & health management for power grid components and systems Apply advanced techniques by combining reliability engineering, physics-of-failure insights, data analysis, mathematical modelling, and system tools to enhance the reliability of mission-critical equipment Collaborate globally with researchers and engineers across Hitachi Energy Research and business units to solve real-world challenges and identify opportunities for improvement Build strong networks within the company and with external partners, including universities, start-ups, and vendors Share your knowledge through scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports   Your background PhD in Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field Solid experience in one or more of the following areas is required: statistical and probabilistic modelling (e.g., Bayesian inference, Monte Carlo simulations), mathematical modelling and simulation (e.g., Markov chains, Poisson processes, Petri nets), data science and machine learning Familiarity with reliability engineering methods or condition health monitoring in domains such as mechanical or electronics is a strong plus Proven track record of scientific publications in top-tier journals and conferences Fluency in English, both written and spoken   More about us   At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every individual. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. Join us in shaping a more sustainable and reliable energy future.

jobs.title: Industrial Engineer for GIS Production 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are seeking a highly motivated Industrial Engineer with a focus on Automation and Robotics to optimize and improve the efficiency of our Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) production lines. This role involves applying industrial engineering principles as well as automation technologies and robotic solutions to enhance manufacturing processes, reduce waste, and improve productivity. Motivated graduates with a strong focus on automation and robotics are also encouraged to apply. How you'll make an impact Analyse current GIS production line layouts, workflows, and operational procedures to identify areas for improvement in efficiency, cost, and quality, with a focus on automation potential Design and implement optimized production processes, including new methodologies, automation concepts, robotic applications, equipment utilization, and material flow Conduct time and motion studies, process mapping, and value stream analysis to identify bottlenecks and eliminate non-value-added activities. jobs.title: Internship in Variability Visualization Framework for Large-Scale Graphical Languages 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity The System and Automation team at the Swiss research center is looking for an intern student with expertise in data processing and visualization, software engineering, or software architecture to contribute to the development of a novel visual framework for variability management in large-scale graphical languages. The intern will interact with dynamic and multidisciplinary teams that will supervise and guide the project. If you have a strong technical background, motivation to develop innovative solutions, and you are goal-oriented, this is your opportunity to contribute to a stronger and more sustainable energy future. The duration of the internship is six months. How you'll make an impact Support the technology development and research activities in variability management for software systems Perform state-of-the-art and technology reviews: Benchmark the achieved results against state-of-the-art solutions for the given application Design, prototype, and\/or integrate tools that support the scalable analysis and management of software variability via intuitive visual interfaces Disseminate and report your results with the teams, write technical documentation, propose creative and efficient solutions towards industrial implementation    Your background The candidate should be enrolled in an MSc program in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Control and Automation Engineering, or a related field The candidate should have a strong background in data engineering, software engineering, and\/or software architecture Experience in Python programming, UI\/UX and\/or simulation tools for power electronics (Simulink, PSCAD, PLECS) are strongly appreciated Excellent communication skills, team player attitude, initiative, and creativity Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: R&D Internship for Magnetics Design in Power Electronic Converter Systems 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity At Hitachi Energy Research, we closely collaborate with business areas to develop foundations for the next generation of Power Grids products. Located in the proximity of Zurich, the research center employs more than 60 scientists from all over the world with cross-disciplinary expertise. In the Systems Integration and Physics Team we address the challenges and opportunities in enhancing grid flexibility and facilitating renewable energy proliferation. A key focus of our work is multi-physics modeling for power electronic systems, which plays a critical role in fast-growing applications such as electric vehicle charging, energy storage and renewables like wind and solar. In this context, we offer an 6 months internship position which provides the opportunity of working on real-world projects in an international team of research scientists. How you'll make an impact Extension of a MATLAB-based tool for systematic and comprehensive design and optimization of magnetic components in power electronic converters Design and comparison of different winding types Design and comparison of different core materials Implementation and testing of models. Documentation of studies and results in technical reports Adaption of the code architecture as necessary to maintain clarity and facilitate easy maintenance Collaboration with an international research team and experts in power electronics    Your background Enrolled in a Master degree program in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer sciences, or a similar discipline (completion of at least six semesters) Experience with MATLAB programming Familiar with magnetics in power electronic converters Enthusiastic, motivated and curious with good organizational skills and team spirit Highly conscientious professional with a strong sense of responsibility and excellent communication skills Fluency in English, written and spoken More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing.

jobs.title: Functional Lead Secondary Engineering Standardization Team 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. Our unit Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS), based in Zürich-Oerlikon, is active in the development and production of gas insulated switching systems. We ensure the high reliability of our systems by using state-of-the-art development tools and methods. For our business unit High Voltage Products we are looking for a Functional Lead of the Standardization Team in Secondary Engineering. In this challenging position you will take over the functional lead for the standardization team to drive forward the product standardization and improvements. You will work closely with the Secondary Engineering team in Switzerland, Germany and India and develop a Standardization Roadmap that guides the development of our product for the future. Together with the standardization team, you will ensure successful implementation of improvements, such as releases of new templates and engineering guidelines that enables Engineering to deliver their projects effectively and in high quality. How you'll make an impact Lead functionally the Secondary Engineering Standardization Team including the daily management of tasks, planning and balancing of team workload, ensuring progress, transparency, and effective utilization of team capacity and development of required competences the team Define of GIS Secondary Engineering design standards through the development of templates and design guidelines with the support of the standardization team and experts Develop, maintain and regularly update of the Secondary Engineering Standardization Roadmap in collaboration with the Standardization team members, Key stakeholders within Secondary Engineering and other departments Engage in the Quality process and Continuous Improvement Cycles of the GIS organization and actively collaborate with other engineering teams and stakeholders to discuss, evaluate and align improvements, and to prioritize them for the implementation Execute and technically lead improvement tasks from the Standardization roadmap individually Drive the standardization and harmonization of E3 templates to provide an efficient and high-quality basis for project-specific schematics Your background Electrical engineering background Demonstrated ability to lead successfully, either in management position or in challenging and complex projects Solid experience in engineering of Secondary Equipment (LCCs) as Secondary Engineering PM Experience of the corresponding tools used for Secondary Engineering Readiness to take over role as functional leadership within a team.   Proven experience in Project Management, Certification e.g. as PMP is a plus Fluency in English. German or any other language is a plus The job owner lives an innovative and performance-oriented thinking as well as following the values of Hitachi Energy and makes a personal contribution to a good working atmosphere More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, è rinomata in tutto il mondo come specialista nella trasmissione e distribuzione di energia. La nostra unità Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS), con sede a Zurigo-Oerlikon, è attiva nello sviluppo e nella produzione di sistemi di commutazione isolati in gas. Garantiamo l'elevata affidabilità dei nostri sistemi utilizzando strumenti e metodi di sviluppo all'avanguardia. Per la nostra business unit Prodotti ad alta tensione stiamo cercando un responsabile funzionale del team di standardizzazione in ingegneria secondaria. In questa posizione impegnativa assumerai la guida funzionale del team di standardizzazione per portare avanti la standardizzazione e i miglioramenti del prodotto. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con il team di ingegneria secondaria in Svizzera, Germania e India e svilupperai una tabella di marcia per la standardizzazione che guida lo sviluppo del nostro prodotto per il futuro. Insieme al team di standardizzazione, garantirai l'implementazione di successo dei miglioramenti, come il rilascio di nuovi modelli e linee guida ingegneristiche che consentano all'ingegneria di fornire i propri progetti in modo efficace e di alta qualità. Come avrai un impatto Guidare in modo funzionale il team di standardizzazione dell'ingegneria secondaria, compresa la gestione quotidiana delle attività, la pianificazione e il bilanciamento del carico di lavoro del team, garantendo progresso, trasparenza e utilizzo efficace delle capacità del team e lo sviluppo delle competenze richieste al team Definire gli standard di progettazione GIS dell'ingegneria secondaria attraverso lo sviluppo di modelli e linee guida di progettazione con il supporto del team di standardizzazione e degli esperti Sviluppare, mantenere e aggiornare regolarmente la tabella di marcia per la standardizzazione dell'ingegneria secondaria in collaborazione con i membri del team di standardizzazione, le principali parti interessate all'interno dell'ingegneria secondaria e altri dipartimenti Impegnarsi nel processo di qualità e nei cicli di miglioramento continuo dell'organizzazione GIS e collaborare attivamente con altri team di ingegneri e parti interessate per discutere, valutare e allineare i miglioramenti e per dare loro priorità per l'implementazione Eseguire e guidare tecnicamente attività di miglioramento dalla roadmap di standardizzazione individualmente Guidare la standardizzazione e l'armonizzazione dei modelli E3 per fornire una base efficiente e di alta qualità per schemi specifici del progetto Il tuo background Background di ingegneria elettrica Dimostrata capacità di guidare con successo, sia in posizione dirigenziale che in progetti impegnativi e complessi Solida esperienza nell'ingegneria di Attrezzatura secondaria (LCC) come PM di ingegneria secondaria Esperienza degli strumenti corrispondenti utilizzati per l'ingegneria secondaria Disponibilità ad assumere il ruolo di leadership funzionale all'interno di un team. Comprovata esperienza nella gestione di progetti, certificazioni, ad es. poiché PMP è un vantaggio. Conoscenza della lingua inglese. Il tedesco o qualsiasi altra lingua è un vantaggio Il titolare del lavoro vive un pensiero innovativo e orientato alle prestazioni, oltre a seguire i valori di Hitachi Energy e fornisce un contributo personale a una buona atmosfera lavorativa Maggiori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando al contempo un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie capacità e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, ist weltweit als Spezialist für Stromübertragung und -verteilung bekannt. Unsere Einheit Gasisolierte Schaltanlagen (GIS) mit Sitz in Zürich-Oerlikon ist in der Entwicklung und Produktion von gasisolierten Schaltanlagen tätig. Die hohe Zuverlässigkeit unserer Systeme stellen wir durch den Einsatz modernster Entwicklungstools und -methoden sicher. Für unseren Geschäftsbereich Hochspannungsprodukte suchen wir einen funktionalen Leiter des Standardisierungsteams im Secondary Engineering. In dieser herausfordernden Position übernehmen Sie die funktionale Leitung des Standardisierungsteams, um die Produktstandardisierung und -verbesserungen voranzutreiben. Sie arbeiten eng mit dem Secondary Engineering-Team in der Schweiz, Deutschland und Indien zusammen und entwickeln eine Standardisierungs-Roadmap, die die Entwicklung unseres Produkts für die Zukunft leitet. Gemeinsam mit dem Standardisierungsteam sorgen Sie für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung von Verbesserungen, wie z. B. die Veröffentlichung neuer Vorlagen und Engineering-Richtlinien, die es dem Engineering ermöglichen, seine Projekte effektiv und in hoher Qualität abzuwickeln. Wie Sie etwas bewirken werden: Führen Sie das Secondary Engineering Standardisierungsteam funktional, einschließlich der täglichen Verwaltung von
• Aufgaben, Planung und Ausgleich der Teamarbeitsbelastung, stellen Sie Fortschritt, Transparenz und effektive Nutzung der Teamkapazität und Entwicklung der erforderlichen Kompetenzen sicher. Definieren Sie GIS Secondary Engineering Designstandards durch die Entwicklung von Vorlagen und Designrichtlinien mit Unterstützung des Standardisierungsteams und von Experten. Entwickeln, pflegen und aktualisieren Sie regelmäßig die Secondary Engineering Standardisierungs-Roadmap in Zusammenarbeit mit den Mitgliedern des Standardisierungsteams, den wichtigsten Interessenvertretern im Secondary Engineering und anderen Abteilungen. Beteiligen Sie sich den Qualitätsprozess und die kontinuierlichen Verbesserungszyklen der GIS-Organisation und arbeiten aktiv mit anderen Engineering-Teams und Stakeholdern zusammen, um Verbesserungen zu diskutieren, zu bewerten und auszurichten und sie für die Implementierung zu priorisieren. Führen Sie Verbesserungsaufgaben aus der Standardisierungs-Roadmap individuell aus und leiten Sie sie technisch. Treiben Sie die Standardisierung und Harmonisierung von E3-Vorlagen voran, um eine effiziente und qualitativ hochwertige Grundlage für projektspezifische Schaltpläne zu bieten. Ihr Hintergrund: Elektrotechnik-Hintergrund. Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, erfolgreich zu leiten, entweder in Managementposition oder in anspruchsvollen und komplexen Projekten. Solide Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Sekundärausrüstung (LCCs) als Secondary Engineering PM Erfahrung mit den entsprechenden Werkzeugen für Secondary Engineering Bereitschaft zur Übernahme einer funktionalen Führungsrolle innerhalb eines Teams. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, Zertifizierung z.B. Da PMP ein Plus ist. Fließende Englischkenntnisse. Deutsch oder jede andere Sprache ist von Vorteil. Der Stelleninhaber lebt ein innovatives und leistungsorientiertes Denken sowie die Werte von Hitachi Energy und trägt persönlich zu einem guten Arbeitsklima bei. Mehr über uns. Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, est reconnu dans le monde entier comme un spécialiste du transport et de la distribution d'énergie. Notre unité Gas Insulated Switchgears (GIS), basée à Zürich-Oerlikon, est active dans le développement et la production de systèmes de commutation à isolation gazeuse. Nous garantissons la haute fiabilité de nos systèmes en utilisant des outils et des méthodes de développement de pointe. Pour notre unité commerciale Produits Haute Tension, nous recherchons un responsable fonctionnel de l'équipe de normalisation en ingénierie secondaire. Dans ce poste stimulant, vous assumerez la direction fonctionnelle de l'équipe de normalisation afin de faire progresser la normalisation et les améliorations des produits. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe d'ingénierie secondaire en Suisse, en Allemagne et en Inde et développerez une feuille de route de normalisation qui guide le développement de notre produit pour l'avenir. En collaboration avec l'équipe de normalisation, vous assurerez la mise en œuvre réussie des améliorations, telles que la publication de nouveaux modèles et de directives d'ingénierie qui permettent à l'ingénierie de réaliser ses projets de manière efficace et de haute qualité. Comment vous aurez un impact Diriger fonctionnellement l'équipe de normalisation de l'ingénierie secondaire, y compris la gestion quotidienne des tâches, la planification et l'équilibrage de la charge de travail de l'équipe, en garantissant les progrès, la transparence et l'utilisation efficace de la capacité de l'équipe et le développement des compétences requises. Définir les normes de conception de l'ingénierie secondaire SIG à travers le développement de modèles et de lignes directrices de conception avec le soutien de l'équipe de normalisation et des experts. Cycles d'amélioration continue de l'organisation SIG et collaborer activement avec d'autres équipes d'ingénierie et parties prenantes pour discuter, évaluer et aligner les améliorations, et les hiérarchiser pour la mise en œuvre. Exécuter et diriger techniquement les tâches d'amélioration de la feuille de route de normalisation individuellement. descriptionByLocale.it: Informazioni sulla posizione Nel nostro centro di profitto a Wettingen produciamo e offriamo soluzioni di protezione contro le sovratensioni innovative, affidabili e sicure per la produzione/distribuzione di energia, nonché per i segmenti ferroviario e industriale. Il nostro obiettivo è supportare i nostri clienti in tutto il mondo con tecnologie di alta qualità e creare valore aggiunto sostenibile. Ciò si ottiene attraverso il continuo sviluppo delle nostre tecnologie chiave e il costante miglioramento dei nostri processi, supportati da una collaborazione aperta e da un forte spirito di squadra. In qualità di leader del team di manutenzione, assumi un ruolo responsabile e guidi un team impegnato di sei dipendenti. Insieme garantite che tutti gli impianti di produzione e i sistemi tecnici funzionino in modo affidabile in un processo di produzione altamente automatizzato. Definisci attivamente l'ulteriore sviluppo della manutenzione, sia dal punto di vista strategico che operativo, e lavori a stretto contatto e in collaborazione con il management e altre aree. L’obiettivo è garantire un’elevata disponibilità del sistema, sicurezza e un’organizzazione efficiente e sostenibile. Questo è ciò che puoi ottenere Insieme al tuo team, l'organizzazione della manutenzione viene ulteriormente sviluppata e rafforzata Pianificazione, coordinamento e implementazione delle misure di manutenzione e riparazione (preventive, correttive e olistiche) sono la tua area di responsabilità Le strategie sostenibili per migliorare la disponibilità, la produttività e la durata di servizio dei sistemi sono avviate e guidate da te Lo sviluppo professionale e personale del tuo team è attivamente supportato e promosso La responsabilità della pianificazione del budget e un uso consapevole e sostenibile delle risorse (inclusi i pezzi di ricambio e la strategia di stoccaggio) fanno parte del tuo ruolo Nella conversione, lavorerai a stretto contatto con vari dipartimenti su nuove costruzioni e progetti di investimento. Garantirai il rispetto degli standard di sicurezza, ambientali e di qualità. I processi verranno continuamente migliorati e integrati da soluzioni moderne e digitali e da sistemi di indicatori chiave di prestazione. Cosa porti con te Titolo di studio tecnico conseguito (es. ingegneria, meccatronica, ingegneria elettrica, tecnologia dell'automazione) o una qualifica comparabile costituisce la tua base. Hai diversi anni di esperienza nella manutenzione e idealmente in un ruolo manageriale all'interno della produzione automatizzata. Hai conoscenza di automazione, robot e sistemi di controllo. L'esperienza con approcci di manutenzione strutturati e miglioramento continuo completa il tuo profilo. Ti piace lavorare con diverse aree specialistiche. La nostra ambizione è supportare i clienti in tutto il mondo con tecnologie di alta qualità e creare valore aggiunto sostenibile. Ciò si ottiene attraverso il continuo progresso delle nostre tecnologie principali e il miglioramento continuo dei nostri processi, guidati da una collaborazione aperta e da un forte spirito di squadra. About the position In our profit center in Wettingen, we produce and offer innovative, reliable and safe surge protection solutions for the power generation/distribution as well as railway and industrial segments. Our aim is to support our customers worldwide with high-quality technologies and to create sustainable added value. This is achieved through the continuous development of our core technologies and the constant improvement of our processes - supported by open collaboration and a strong team spirit. As a maintenance team leader, you take on a responsible role and lead a committed team of six employees. Together you ensure that all production facilities and technical systems function reliably in highly automated process production. You actively shape the further development of maintenance - both strategically and operationally - and work closely and in partnership with management and other areas. The aim is to ensure high system availability, safety and an efficient and sustainable organization. This is what you can achieve Together with your team, the maintenance organization is further developed and strengthened Planning, coordination and implementation of maintenance and repair measures (preventive, corrective and holistic) are your area of responsibility Sustainable strategies to improve the availability, productivity and service life of the systems are initiated and driven by you The professional and personal development of your team is actively supported and promoted Responsibility for budget planning as well as a conscious and sustainable use of resources (including spare parts and storage strategy) are part of your role In conversion, You will work closely with various departments on new construction and investment projects. You will ensure compliance with safety, environmental and quality standards. Processes will be continuously improved and supplemented by modern, digital solutions and key performance indicator systems.
• What you bring with you A completed technical degree (e.g. Engineering, mechatronics, electrical engineering, automation technology) or a comparable qualification forms your basis. You have several years of experience in maintenance and ideally in a managerial role within automated production. You have knowledge of automation, robots and control systems. Experience with structured maintenance approaches and continuous improvement rounds off your profile. You enjoy working with different specialist areas. descriptionByLocale.fr: À propos du poste Dans notre centre de profit de Wettingen, nous produisons et proposons des solutions de protection contre les surtensions innovantes, fiables et sûres pour les secteurs de la production/distribution d'électricité ainsi que des secteurs ferroviaire et industriel. Notre objectif est de soutenir nos clients dans le monde entier avec des technologies de haute qualité et de créer une valeur ajoutée durable. Ceci est réalisé grâce au développement continu de nos technologies de base et à l’amélioration constante de nos processus – soutenus par une collaboration ouverte et un fort esprit d’équipe. En tant que chef d'équipe de maintenance, vous assumez un rôle responsable et dirigez une équipe engagée de six employés. Ensemble, vous veillez à ce que toutes les installations de production et tous les systèmes techniques fonctionnent de manière fiable dans le cadre d'une production hautement automatisée. Vous façonnez activement le développement futur de la maintenance - tant sur le plan stratégique qu'opérationnel - et travaillez en étroite collaboration et en partenariat avec la direction et d'autres domaines. L’objectif est de garantir une disponibilité élevée du système, la sécurité et une organisation efficace et durable. C'est ce que vous pouvez réaliser En collaboration avec votre équipe, l'organisation de maintenance est développée et renforcée. La planification, la coordination et la mise en œuvre des mesures de maintenance et de réparation (préventives, correctives et holistiques) relèvent de votre responsabilité. Des stratégies durables visant à améliorer la disponibilité, la productivité et la durée de vie des systèmes sont initiées et pilotées par vous. Le développement professionnel et personnel de votre équipe est activement soutenu et encouragé. La responsabilité de la planification budgétaire ainsi que d'une utilisation consciente et durable des ressources (y compris les pièces de rechange et la stratégie de stockage) font partie de votre rôle. Lors de la conversion, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec divers départements sur les nouveaux projets de construction et d'investissement. Vous veillerez au respect des normes de sécurité, environnementales et de qualité. Les processus seront continuellement améliorés et complétés par des solutions numériques modernes et des systèmes d'indicateurs de performance clés. Ce que vous apportez avec vous Un diplôme technique complété (par ex. Ingénierie, mécatronique, électrotechnique, technologie d'automatisation) ou une qualification comparable constitue votre base. Vous possédez plusieurs années d'expérience en maintenance et idéalement dans un rôle managérial au sein d'une production automatisée. Vous avez des connaissances en automatisation, robots et systèmes de contrôle. Une expérience des approches de maintenance structurées et d’amélioration continue complète votre profil. Vous aimez travailler avec différents domaines spécialisés. Une façon de travailler structurée et orientée vers les solutions combinée à une capacité d'accompagnement et de développement des personnes est ce qui vous différencie. Une très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais est requise. En savoir plus sur nous Nos modèles de travail flexibles vous aident à bien combiner travail et vie privée. Un environnement valorisant est important pour nous afin que vous puissiez vous impliquer, vous développer davantage et libérer votre potentiel. --- Traduction en anglais ci-dessous --- Chef d'équipe Maintenance 80–100 % (f\/m\/d) L'opportunité Dans notre centre de profit de parasurtenseurs à Wettingen, vous travaillerez avec nous pour développer, fabriquer et fournir des solutions de protection contre les surtensions innovantes, fiables et sûres pour les secteurs de la production et de la distribution d'électricité, des chemins de fer et de l'industrie. jobs.title: Shift Equipment Maintenance Engineer – Etching 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity  Join our innovative team as a Shift Maintenance Engineer and play a critical role in the heart of semiconductor production! With a strong focus on etching processes, you'll work with cutting-edge technology to optimize system performance and ensure seamless operations. This is your opportunity to collaborate with experts, contribute to groundbreaking projects, and grow in a dynamic, high-tech environment. If you're passionate about precision and innovation, we want to hear from you!   How you'll make an impact  Maintain and optimize wet chemical and plasma etch equipment to ensure high availability  Troubleshoot and repair complex systems in collaboration with OEM partners  Plan and support preventive maintenance activities to improve tool performance  Manage spare parts and contribute to equipment upgrades and process improvements  Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and operations teams to support production goals  Create and maintain technical documentation and support data tracking in MES systems  Identify and implement improvements in tools, processes, and operational efficiency  Ensure compliance with HSE standards and promote a safe working environment  Your background  Technical vocational training in automation, electronics, or a related field (EFZ or equivalent)  2+ years of experience in equipment maintenance in semiconductor or similar industries  Strong technical knowledge in plasma tools (e.g. AMAT, LAM systems)  Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, pneumatics, and vacuum systems  Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and within shift operations  Good communication skills in English (German is a plus)  More about us   You will join a dynamic and fast-paced production environment where teamwork, reliability, and technical excellence are key.  Working in a shift-based setup, you will be part of a highly skilled maintenance team supporting critical operations and advanced manufacturing processes.  This role offers hands-on experience with complex technologies and the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing directly to production stability and performance.

descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Rejoignez notre équipe innovante en tant qu'ingénieur de maintenance Shift et jouez un rôle essentiel au cœur de la production de semi-conducteurs ! En mettant l'accent sur les processus de gravure, vous travaillerez avec une technologie de pointe pour optimiser les performances du système et garantir des opérations transparentes. jobs.title: Service Sales Engineer – Transformer Service (Traction/Rail) 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a Service Sales Engineer for our Traction Transformers Service Business Unit, in Geneva (Switzerland). Reporting to the Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager you will support the Sales organization and customers throughout the sales process in the assigned area. You will be part of the Sales Team that focuses on Traction Transformer Service in Europe. As Service Sales Engineer it is your exciting task to facilitate the sustainable mobility transition by a cutting-edge rail product and rail service portfolio for rolling stock equipment. In this team, you will work with international peers having many years of experience within the on-board traction transformer service business for rolling stock equipment. Based in Geneva, the role will assume responsibility for the rail customers in Europe (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies). If you are a highly skilled and motivated engineer looking to join a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply. How you'll make an impact Supporting the Sales team and customers throughout the sales process, while developing new and existing business by increasing internal and external knowledge of products and market Preparing technical offer in accordance with Unit portfolio and customer need. Clarifying technical and commercial aspects of the offer Participating in sales strategy discussions, assigning short- and long-term goals and negotiating the various Product Group sales budgets and marketing plans Identifying customer needs and competitor offers through market analysis, ensuring efficient marketing actions and communications demonstrate the value proposition of the products, systems, service and packages Supporting the area Sales organization\/customers in determining the most technically appropriate and cost-effective solutions and providing technical support, product presentations and product\/solution\/service-related training Taking ownership of specific customer cases to ensure efficient customer issue resolution and analyzing the root cause of any lost proposals, to increase future competitiveness Performing sales performance reviews, proposing recovery plans in cases of potential order shortfalls and providing regular sales activity reports to assist in production planning Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business Your background Bachelor's degree in engineering and more than 2 years of experience in direct sales and sales management Knowledge of rail rolling stock market and rail customers (OEM train manufacturers, rail operators, leasing companies) is an advantage Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken. Other languages are an advantage Experience in business development, account management and cross-selling across systems, solutions, products and service categories Understanding of offer preparation, contract negotiation, risk management and commercial and legal terms Traveling mainly within the European Union if needed. Frequent interaction with rail customers and HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team are expected More about us Our flexible working methods help you optimize your personal and professional performance and create an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

I nostri metodi di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le tue prestazioni personali e professionali e a creare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.de: Die Chance Wir suchen einen Service Sales Engineer für unsere Traction Transformers Service Business Unit in Genf (Schweiz). Berichterstattung an den Traction Service Sales and Marketing Manager Sie werden die Verkaufsorganisation und Kunden während des gesamten Verkaufsprozesses in dem zugewiesenen Bereich unterstützen. Sie werden Teil des Verkaufsteams sein, das sich auf Traction Transformer Service in Europa konzentriert. Als Service Sales Engineer ist es Ihre spannende Aufgabe, die nachhaltige Mobilitätswende durch ein hochmodernes Schienenprodukt- und Schienendienstleistungsportfolio für Fahrzeuge zu ermöglichen. In diesem Team arbeiten Sie mit internationalen Kollegen zusammen, die über langjährige Erfahrung im Bereich der On-Board-Traktionstransformatoren-Services für Fahrzeuge verfügen. Wenn Sie ein hochqualifizierter und motivierter Ingenieur sind, der sich einem dynamischen Team anschließen möchte, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben. Wie Sie Einfluss darauf haben, das Verkaufsteam und die Kunden während des gesamten Verkaufsprozesses zu unterstützen und gleichzeitig neue und bestehende Geschäfte zu entwickeln, indem Sie das interne und externe Wissen über Produkte und den Markt erweitern. Klären der technischen und kommerziellen Aspekte des Angebots Teilnahme an Verkaufsstrategie Diskussionen, Zuweisung kurz- und langfristiger Ziele und Verhandlungen der verschiedenen Produktgruppe Verkaufsbudgets und Marketingpläne Identifizierung der Kundenbedürfnisse und Angebote der Wettbewerber durch Marktanalyse, Gewährleistung effizienter Marketingaktionen und Kommunikationen zeigen das Wertversprechen der Produkte, Systeme, Service und Pakete Unterstützung des Bereichs Verkaufsorganisation / Kunden bei der Bestimmung der technisch angemessensten und kosteneffektivsten Lösungen und Bereitstellung von technischem Support, Produktpräsentationen und Produkt / Lösung / Service-bezogenes Training Übernahme der Verantwortung für spezifische Kundenfälle, um eine effiziente Lösung von Kundenproblemen zu gewährleisten und die zukünftige Wettbewerbsfähigkeit zu erhöhen Durchführung von Verkaufsleistungsüberprüfungen, Vorschlag von Wiederherstellungsplänen in Fällen von möglichen Auftragslücken und Bereitstellung regelmäßiger Verkaufsaktivitäten Berichte zur Unterstützung bei der Produktionsplanung Leben Kernwerte der Sicherheit und Integrität, was bedeutet, Verantwortung für Ihre eigenen Handlungen zu übernehmen, während Sie sich um Ihre Kollegen und das Unternehmen kümmern Ihr Bachelor-Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften und mehr als 2 Jahre Erfahrung im Direktvertrieb und Vertriebsmanagement Kenntnisse des Schienenfahrzeugmarktes und der Schienenkunden (OEM-Zughersteller, Bahnbetreiber, Leasinggesellschaften) sind ein Vorteil, der sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich fließend Französisch und Englisch spricht. Häufige Interaktion mit Bahnkunden und HITACHI Energy European Front-End-Sales Team werden erwartet Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, Ihre persönliche und berufliche Leistung zu optimieren und ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Service Sales Engineer pour notre service de transformation de traction, à Genève (Suisse). Sous l'autorité du directeur des ventes et du marketing du service de traction, vous soutiendrez l'organisation des ventes et les clients tout au long du processus de vente dans la zone attribuée. Vous ferez partie de l'équipe de vente qui se concentre sur le service Transformateur de Traction en Europe. En tant que Service Sales Engineer, c'est votre tâche passionnante de faciliter la transition vers une mobilité durable grâce à un portefeuille de produits ferroviaires et de services ferroviaires de pointe pour le matériel roulant. Dans cette équipe, vous travaillerez avec des pairs internationaux ayant de nombreuses années d'expérience dans le domaine des transformateurs de traction embarqués pour le matériel roulant. Basé à Genève, ce rôle assumera la responsabilité des clients ferroviaires en Europe (fabricants de trains OEM, opérateurs ferroviaires, sociétés de location). Si vous êtes un ingénieur hautement qualifié et motivé cherchant à rejoindre une équipe dynamique, nous vous encourageons à postuler. Comment vous allez avoir un impact Soutenir l'équipe des ventes et les clients tout au long du processus de vente, tout en développant des activités nouvelles et existantes en augmentant les connaissances internes et externes des produits et du marché. Clarifier les aspects techniques et commerciaux de l'offre Participer aux discussions sur la stratégie de vente, assigner des objectifs à court et à long terme et négocier les différents budgets de vente et plans de marketing du Groupe de produits Identifier les besoins des clients et les offres des concurrents par l'analyse du marché, assurer des actions de marketing et des communications efficaces démontrer la proposition de valeur des produits, systèmes, services et forfaits Soutenir la région Organisme de vente/clients pour déterminer les solutions les plus appropriées et les plus rentables sur le plan technique et fournir un soutien technique, des présentations de produits et une formation liée au produit/solution\/service S'approprier des cas particuliers des clients pour assurer une résolution efficace des problèmes des clients et analyser la cause fondamentale de toute proposition perdue, accroître la compétitivité future Effectuer des examens du rendement des ventes, proposer des plans de récupération en cas de manque potentiel de commandes et fournir des rapports réguliers d'activités de vente pour aider à la planification de la production Vivre des valeurs fondamentales de sécurité et d'intégrité, ce qui signifie assumer la responsabilité de vos propres actions tout en prenant soin de vos collègues et de l'entreprise Votre formation Baccalauréat en ingénierie et plus de 2 ans d'expérience en vente directe et gestion des ventes Connaissance du marché du matériel roulant ferroviaire et des clients ferroviaires (fabricants de trains OEM, exploitants ferroviaires, sociétés de location) est un avantage Fluent en français et en anglais, à la fois écrit et parlé. D'autres langues sont un avantage Expérience en développement d'entreprise, gestion de compte et vente croisée entre systèmes, solutions, produits et catégories de services Compréhension de la préparation de l'offre, négociation de contrat, gestion des risques et conditions commerciales et juridiques Voyage principalement au sein de l'Union européenne si nécessaire.
