jobs.title: Cluster Security Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity In this role, you will serve as a recognized subject matter expert in security, providing competent functional support across a country or cluster of countries. You will be responsible for researching, analysing, and interpreting emerging security threats that could impact employees, assets, or operations. You will play a key role in organizational resilience, crisis management, and the implementation of Hitachi Energy's global and regional security strategies. Reporting to the Head of Regional Security, you will manage complex projects with limited supervision, coach lower-level professionals, and contribute to critical business decisions through expert security insights. How you'll make an impact Analyze emerging domestic and international security threats and provide timely assessments and advisories. Deliver competent security support across the country\/cluster, ensuring alignment with regional security standards and KPIs. Ensure compliance through audits, inspections, and monitoring of evolving security legislation. Provide expert security risk management advice to support key business decisions. Drive continuous improvement and behavioural change through global and regional security initiatives. Engage internal and external stakeholders to strengthen security awareness and performance. Lead or support security-related projects, managing objectives, resources, and reporting. Coordinate organizational resilience, emergency response, and country-level crisis management. Your background Min. 5 years Advanced education and significant experience as a security specialist. Proven expertise in threat intelligence, risk analysis, and crisis management. Strong understanding of security standards, legislation, compliance requirements, and audit processes. Experience coaching and advising leaders on security matters within a complex organization. Business fluent in German and English. Demonstrated ability to manage security programs, projects, and budgets effectively. Skilled in stakeholder engagement, communication, and cross-functional collaboration. Experience in organizational resilience, emergency response, and business continuity coordination. Ability to operate in a global matrix environment and manage responsibilities across multiple countries. Approx. 30% Travel required More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità In questo ruolo, ricoprirai il ruolo di esperto riconosciuto in materia di sicurezza, fornendo supporto funzionale competente in un paese o un gruppo di paesi. Sarai responsabile della ricerca, dell'analisi e dell'interpretazione delle minacce alla sicurezza emergenti che potrebbero avere un impatto su dipendenti, risorse o operazioni. Avrai un ruolo chiave nella resilienza organizzativa, nella gestione delle crisi e nell'implementazione delle strategie di sicurezza globali e regionali di Hitachi Energy. Riportando al responsabile della sicurezza regionale, gestirai progetti complessi con supervisione limitata, istruirai professionisti di livello inferiore e contribuirai a decisioni aziendali critiche attraverso approfondimenti di esperti sulla sicurezza. Come avrai un impatto Analizza le minacce emergenti alla sicurezza nazionale e internazionale e fornisci valutazioni e consulenze tempestive. Fornire supporto di sicurezza competente in tutto il paese/cluster, garantendo l'allineamento con gli standard di sicurezza e i KPI regionali. Garantisci la conformità attraverso audit, ispezioni e monitoraggio dell'evoluzione della legislazione sulla sicurezza. Fornire consulenza esperta sulla gestione dei rischi per la sicurezza per supportare le decisioni aziendali chiave. Promuovere il miglioramento continuo e il cambiamento comportamentale attraverso iniziative di sicurezza globali e regionali. Coinvolgere le parti interessate interne ed esterne per rafforzare la consapevolezza e le prestazioni in materia di sicurezza. Guidare o supportare progetti relativi alla sicurezza, gestendo obiettivi, risorse e reporting. Coordinare la resilienza organizzativa, la risposta alle emergenze e la gestione delle crisi a livello nazionale. Il tuo backgroundMin. 5 anni di formazione avanzata e significativa esperienza come specialista della sicurezza. Comprovata esperienza nell'intelligence sulle minacce, nell'analisi dei rischi e nella gestione delle crisi. Ottima conoscenza degli standard di sicurezza, della legislazione, dei requisiti di conformità e dei processi di audit. Esperienza di coaching e consulenza ai leader su questioni di sicurezza all'interno di un'organizzazione complessa. Affari fluente in tedesco e inglese. Capacità dimostrata di gestire programmi, progetti e budget di sicurezza in modo efficace. Abile nel coinvolgimento degli stakeholder, nella comunicazione e nella collaborazione interfunzionale. Esperienza nella resilienza organizzativa, nella risposta alle emergenze e nel coordinamento della continuità aziendale. Capacità di operare in un ambiente a matrice globale e gestire responsabilità in più paesi. ca. 30% Viaggio richiesto Maggiori informazioni su di noi Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando al contempo un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le proprie competenze e crescere.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance: In dieser Rolle fungieren Sie als anerkannter Fachexperte für Sicherheit und bieten kompetente funktionale Unterstützung in einem Land oder einer Ländergruppe. Sie sind für die Erforschung, Analyse und Interpretation neu auftretender Sicherheitsbedrohungen verantwortlich, die sich auf Mitarbeiter, Vermögenswerte oder Abläufe auswirken könnten. Sie spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der organisatorischen Widerstandsfähigkeit, dem Krisenmanagement und der Umsetzung der globalen und regionalen Sicherheitsstrategien von Hitachi Energy. Als Berichterstatter an den Leiter der regionalen Sicherheit leiten Sie komplexe Projekte mit begrenzter Aufsicht, coachen untergeordnete Fachkräfte und tragen durch fachkundige Sicherheitskenntnisse zu wichtigen Geschäftsentscheidungen bei. Wie Sie etwas bewirken können Analysieren Sie aufkommende nationale und internationale Sicherheitsbedrohungen und stellen Sie zeitnahe Bewertungen und Ratschläge bereit. Bieten Sie kompetente Sicherheitsunterstützung im ganzen Land/Cluster und stellen Sie die Übereinstimmung mit regionalen Sicherheitsstandards und KPIs sicher. Stellen Sie die Einhaltung durch Audits, Inspektionen und Überwachung der sich entwickelnden Sicherheitsgesetze sicher. Bieten Sie fachkundige Beratung zum Sicherheitsrisikomanagement, um wichtige Geschäftsentscheidungen zu unterstützen. Fördern Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungen und Verhaltensänderungen durch globale und regionale Sicherheitsinitiativen. Binden Sie interne und externe Stakeholder ein, um das Sicherheitsbewusstsein und die Leistung zu stärken. Leiten oder unterstützen Sie sicherheitsrelevante Projekte und verwalten Sie Ziele, Ressourcen und Berichte. Koordinieren Sie die Widerstandsfähigkeit der Organisation, die Notfallreaktion und das Krisenmanagement auf Landesebene. Ihr Hintergrund: Min. 5 Jahre Fortgeschrittene Ausbildung und umfangreiche Erfahrung als Sicherheitsspezialist. Nachgewiesene Expertise in Bedrohungsanalyse, Risikoanalyse und Krisenmanagement. Ausgeprägtes Verständnis von Sicherheitsstandards, Gesetzen, Compliance-
• Anforderungen und Audit-Prozessen. Erleben Sie Coaching und Beratung von Führungskräften in Sicherheitsfragen innerhalb einer komplexen Organisation. Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Sicherheitsprogramme, Projekte und Budgets effektiv zu verwalten. Versiert in Stakeholder-Engagement, Kommunikation und funktionsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit. Erfahrung in organisatorischer Belastbarkeit, Notfallreaktion und Geschäftskontinuitätskoordination. Fähigkeit, in einer globalen Matrixumgebung zu agieren und Verantwortlichkeiten über mehrere Länder hinweg zu verwalten. Ca. 30 % Reiseaufwand Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitspraktiken helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Dans ce rôle, vous agirez en tant qu'expert reconnu en matière de sécurité, fournissant un soutien fonctionnel compétent dans un pays ou un groupe de pays. Vous serez responsable de rechercher, d’analyser et d’interpréter les menaces de sécurité émergentes qui pourraient avoir un impact sur les employés, les actifs ou les opérations. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la résilience organisationnelle, la gestion des crises et la mise en œuvre des stratégies de sécurité mondiales et régionales d'Hitachi Energy. Relevant du chef de la sécurité régionale, vous gérerez des projets complexes avec une supervision limitée, coacherez des professionnels de niveau inférieur et contribuerez aux décisions commerciales critiques grâce à des informations d'experts en matière de sécurité. Comment vous aurez un impact Analysez les menaces émergentes à la sécurité nationale et internationale et fournissez des évaluations et des avis en temps opportun. Fournir un soutien de sécurité compétent dans tout le pays/cluster, en garantissant l'alignement avec les normes de sécurité régionales et les KPI. Assurer la conformité par le biais d’audits, d’inspections et de surveillance de l’évolution de la législation en matière de sécurité. Fournir des conseils d’experts en matière de gestion des risques de sécurité pour soutenir les décisions commerciales clés. Favoriser l’amélioration continue et le changement de comportement grâce à des initiatives de sécurité mondiales et régionales. Engager les parties prenantes internes et externes pour renforcer la sensibilisation et les performances en matière de sécurité. Diriger ou soutenir des projets liés à la sécurité, en gérant les objectifs, les ressources et les rapports. Coordonner la résilience organisationnelle, les interventions d’urgence et la gestion des crises au niveau national. Votre parcours Min. 5 ans de formation supérieure et expérience significative en tant que spécialiste de la sécurité. Expertise avérée en matière de renseignement sur les menaces, d’analyse des risques et de gestion de crise. Solide compréhension des normes de sécurité, de la législation, des exigences de conformité et des processus d'audit. Expérience d'encadrement et de conseil aux dirigeants sur les questions de sécurité au sein d'une organisation complexe. Affaires parlant couramment l'allemand et l'anglais. Capacité démontrée à gérer efficacement les programmes, les projets et les budgets de sécurité. Compétent en engagement des parties prenantes, en communication et en collaboration interfonctionnelle. Expérience en matière de résilience organisationnelle, d’intervention d’urgence et de coordination de la continuité des activités. Capacité à opérer dans un environnement matriciel mondial et à gérer des responsabilités dans plusieurs pays. Env. 30 % Déplacement requis En savoir plus sur nous Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser vos performances personnelles et professionnelles tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et grandir.

jobs.title: HSE Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The Opportunity Join Hitachi Energy as an HSE professional and play a key role in driving a strong health, safety, and environmental culture within our factory operations in Zurich. You will partner closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure compliance, minimize risks, and continuously improve HSE performance while supporting sustainable and safe operations. descriptionByLocale.en:

jobs.title: Semiconductor Shift Maintenance Engineer – Implant 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As an Implant Maintenance Engineer\/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line. How you'll make an impact Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of implant equipment Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of implant, safety, and best maintenance practices Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations Your background Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics Minimum 3 years of experience with ion implanters (such as AMAT or Nissin or Axcelis) Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (Semilab WT-2000) Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field) Willingness to work in shifts is a must Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus) More about us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

jobs.title: Senior Project Engineer - Grid Automation Control & Protection 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity To strengthen our team, we are seeking a Senior Project Engineer with a strong focus on protection systems for substation automation projects. In this role, you will take technical ownership of the Control & Protection scope within complex (sub‑)transmission projects in Switzerland and internationally, acting as a key technical authority from base design through commissioning. You will work closely with project management, customers, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to define, coordinate, and deliver robust protection solutions in line with system requirements, applicable standards, and Hitachi Energy best practices. You will become part of a world-class engineering community within our European Hub, working alongside highly experienced colleagues with deep expertise in the execution of large and complex projects worldwide. This position offers an excellent environment to learn, develop, and actively contribute to Hitachi Energy's purpose of advancing a sustainable, flexible, and secure energy system. It is a unique opportunity to be part of an exciting phase in which electricity is becoming the backbone of a sustainable society. How you'll make an impact Lead and own the Control & Protection engineering scope in substation automation system projects Define protection concepts and philosophies in close collaboration with the technical lead engineering and with customers during the base design phase Coordinate and guide the Protection & Control detailed engineering, ensuring alignment with SCADA, station control, and cyber security disciplines Specify, configure and test protection IEDs in line with customer requirements, grid codes, and standards Support and lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) at our test facilities in Baden (Switzerland) Your background Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with solid experience in protection engineering for substation automation systems Proven expertise in protection schemes for (sub‑)transmission substations Strong knowledge of IEC 61850 and substation automation architectures Experience with Hitachi Energy Relion® protection IEDs is a strong advantage Able to work independently, take technical decisions, and manage interfaces in complex projects Strong communication skills and a structured, quality‑driven mindset Fluent in English; German is an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. The Service unit is responsible for the worldwide after sales support of generator circuit-breaker (GCB) systems and gas insulated switchgears (GIS), including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, added value services, troubleshooting, extensions, retrofits and replacements. Service is the key to success. As a colleague in our globally active service team, you will appreciate the independent, varied and solution-oriented work. After a versatile, practice-oriented training in Switzerland and abroad, you will lead new GIS installations around the globe. A technically challenging position in a multicultural environment awaits you. You can expect an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow in it. Senior as well as junior applications are welcome! How you will make an impact Managing multicultural construction sites worldwide for gas insulated switchgear for the voltage level of 110KV - 550KV. Responsible for the successful execution of on-site installation \/ maintenance \/ repairs in compliance with contractual deadlines and in compliance with local legal requirements. Responsible for the quality of work performed on site through quality control and assessment of skills of local support staff. Conduct on-site product training on the product and during installation (optional). Coordination of local labor. Cost control of resources used and regular reporting to project management. Actively contribute to process improvements and proactively take measures to increase the efficiency of on-site activities. Your background Completed apprenticeship in the metal construction, electrical or automotive industry, or similar Basic knowledge in electrical engineering is a desirable must, further training in electrical engineering is an advantage Work experience in assembly & commissioning is an advantage Very good German and good English skills, at least B2 Willingness for national and especially international worldwide assignments with up to 90 % travel time Flexible, resilient and communicative team player Flair for pragmatic and unconventional solutions with high quality and safety standards More about us Exciting and varied tasks with great creative freedom Attractive training and development opportunities Interesting and very varied activities\/projects, including off-shore assignments Well-established and dynamic team Open corporate culture An attractive benefits package including fixed, travel and meal expenses, as well as a say in the choice of accommodation

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, è rinomata in tutto il mondo come specialista nella trasmissione e distribuzione di energia. L'unità di assistenza è responsabile del supporto post-vendita di sistemi di interruttore a generatore (GBB) e di interruttori isolati a gas (GIS), tra cui formazione, installazione e messa in servizio, manutenzione programmata, servizi a valore aggiunto, risoluzione dei problemi, estensioni, retrofit e sostituzioni. Il servizio è la chiave del successo. Come collega nel nostro team di assistenza attivo a livello globale, apprezzerete il lavoro indipendente, vario e orientato alla soluzione. Dopo un'esperienza pratica in Svizzera e all'estero, guiderai nuove installazioni GIS in tutto il mondo. Una posizione tecnicamente impegnativa in un ambiente multiculturale ti aspetta. Puoi aspettarti un ambiente dove tutti i dipendenti possano sviluppare le proprie competenze e crescere in esso. Sono benvenute applicazioni senior e junior! Come fare un impatto Gestire siti di costruzione multiculturali in tutto il mondo per gli interruttori isolati a gas per il livello di tensione di 110KV - 550KV. Responsabile della riuscita dell'esecuzione dell'installazione in loco \/ manutenzione \/ riparazione in conformità alle scadenze contrattuali e in conformità alle norme di legge locali. Responsabile della qualità del lavoro svolto in loco attraverso il controllo della qualità e la valutazione delle competenze del personale di supporto locale. Eseguire la formazione sul prodotto in loco e durante l'installazione (opzionale). Coordinamento del lavoro locale. Controllo dei costi delle risorse utilizzate e regolare reporting alla gestione del progetto. Contribuire attivamente a migliorare i processi e adottare misure proattive per aumentare l'efficienza delle attività in loco. jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a [Global\/Regional] Product Specialist to join our innovative team in [location]. In this role, you will play a key part in managing the transformers product portfolio, conducting market analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct thorough market analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the Transformer portfolio. Provide a fresh perspective on differentiating a mature technology and product in the market by analyzing market trends, understanding customer needs, and monitoring competitors' actions with an innovative and creative approach. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on assigned products. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. Develop and deliver engaging training sessions to empower cross-functional teams with the latest product knowledge and market insights. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, market analysis, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product development. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously

È possibile ottenere questo supporto nell'analisi di messaggi di qualità e problemi di produzione Collaborazione nel miglioramento continuo dei processi di risoluzione dei problemi Chiudi la cooperazione con interfacce interne come la produzione, la qualità, l'ingegneria e la pianificazione Supporto nella valutazione dei dati di produzione e qualità Documentazione di misure e follow-up di iniziative di miglioramento Collaborazione nelle recensioni interne e audit Con gli studi in corso o la formazione completa nel campo dell'ingegneria elettrica, dell'ingegneria meccanica, dell'ingegneria industriale, dell'ingegneria industriale o comparabile Prima esperienza pratica nell'ambiente industriale di vantaggio, idealmente con riferimento alla produzione, all'industrializzazione, alla digitalizzazione o all'automazione dei processi Forte interesse nei processi produttivi, nell'analisi della qualità e dei problemi, nonché un metodo di lavoro analitico, strutturato e indipendente. Promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo in cui ogni opinione conta e puoi contribuire alle tue idee, indipendentemente dall'origine, dal sesso o dallo sfondo.

jobs.title: R&D Transformer Service Operations domain expert (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity: For our Transformer Global Team we are looking for R&D Transformer Service Operations domain expert (f\/m\/d) In this role you will be responsible for supporting and leading Research and Development projects related to Transformer Service Operations. Your focus will be contribution towards operations around transformer service portfolio, best practices collection, standardization and coordination of improvements within Transformer Service HUBs and local units together with Technology Centers and Research teams. How will you make an impact: Run standardization projects, propose and develop new operational concepts around new services, and simulate their expected performance in real pilots. Organize prototyping and testing activities to validate new \/ existing transformer services. Making standard policies, instructions, training material to ensure the effective implementation of the targeted processes from operational, quality and knowledge transfer standpoint. Provide support to other team member as well as local units when needed (operations, engineering, product management, product marketing, ...) Participate in, and assist team members in a variety of more complex operations activities. Global collaboration with scientists of Hitachi Energy Research team and Technology Centers, Technology Managers and Engineers from the various GPGs (Service \/ PT \/ DT). Your background: MSc education within Electrical or Mechanical Engineering field. More than 10 years of proven experience within Power Transformers operations. Experience in transformer service portfolio within multinational environment will be highly valued. Ability to use effective methodologies around knowledge and experience capture. Ability to create technical and operational documentation, training instructions… Spirit of innovation, out of the box thinking. Excellent abilities in teamwork in international teams with excellent interpersonal skills. A high level of self-motivation. A collaborative, structured, problem-solving, self-driven, solutions-oriented approach and strong communication skills. Fluent spoken and written English. Other languages will be an advantage. More about us: Our employee benefit programs are tailored to each country, depending on  location of employment and job grade. More specific information on the employee benefit program offering in your intended country of employment\/ more information will be available during the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Process Engineer BiMOS Backend 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity As a global leader in power semiconductor technology, we offer one of the most diverse product portfolios in the industry. Our products include thyristors, diodes, gate turn-off thyristors, integrated gate-commutated thyristors, insulated-gate bipolar transistors, and metal–oxide–semiconductor field-effect transistors. These components are trusted across sectors such as power transmission and distribution, mobility, and renewable energy for their exceptional quality and reliability. In the role of Process Engineer for BiMOS Backend, you will contribute to the advancement of our automated semiconductor production. You'll have the opportunity to improve existing manufacturing processes and lead innovative development projects, with a particular focus on automation and metal joining technologies. How you'll make an impact Improve the capability and quality of bonding and welding processes, by applying data analysis tools and designed experiments Analyze production data to optimize performance, identify long-term trends, and prevent potential failures Work on new automated production systems, improving production capacity and quality Support troubleshooting and root cause analysis to maintain and improve production throughput Collaborate to new product development by shaping the production process landscape and enabling volume manufacturing   Your background A master's degree in industrial, mechanical, electrical, or chemical engineering, or a related field Several years of experience in an automated production environment, ideally within the semiconductor industry Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, a quality-focused mindset, and a proactive, hands-on approach Familiarity with DoE, data analysis, Six Sigma methodologies, and production statistics is a plus Proficiency in both German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Come leader globale nella tecnologia dei semiconduttori di potenza, offriamo uno dei portafogli di prodotti più diversi nel settore. I nostri prodotti includono tiristori, diodi, tiristori a cancello, tiristori integrati a cancello, transistor bipolari a porte isolate e transistor a effetto campo a semiconduttore metallico. Questi componenti sono affidabili in settori come la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia, la mobilità e l'energia rinnovabile per la loro eccezionale qualità e affidabilità. Nel ruolo di Process Engineer per BiMOS Backend, contribuirai all'avanzamento della nostra produzione automatizzata di semiconduttori. Avrete l'opportunità di migliorare i processi produttivi esistenti e di condurre progetti di sviluppo innovativi, con particolare attenzione all'automazione e alle tecnologie di giunzione dei metalli. Migliorare la capacità e la qualità dei processi di incollaggio e saldatura, applicando strumenti di analisi dei dati e sperimentazioni progettate Analizzare i dati di produzione per ottimizzare le prestazioni, identificare le tendenze a lungo termine, e prevenire potenziali guasti Lavorare su nuovi sistemi di produzione automatizzati, migliorare la capacità di produzione e la qualità Supporta la risoluzione dei problemi e l'analisi delle cause principali per mantenere e migliorare il throughput di produzione Collaborare a nuovo sviluppo del prodotto modellando il paesaggio di processo di produzione e consentendo la produzione di volume.

descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité En tant que leader mondial de la technologie des semi-conducteurs électriques, nous offrons l'un des portefeuilles de produits les plus diversifiés de l'industrie. jobs.description: The opportunity As part of our ongoing digital transformation journey, we are developing ACE, a cutting-edge Generative AI-powered platform designed to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of our Bid & Proposal Management process within the Transformers Business Unit. We are seeking a Prompt Engineer who will play a pivotal role in this initiative. This individual will be responsible for designing, testing, and optimizing domain-specific prompts that enable ACE to generate accurate, context-aware, and business-aligned outputs. The role requires a deep understanding of transformer industry, industrial equipment standards as well as basic understanding of prompt engineering best practices and GenAI model behavior, ensuring that ACE delivers high-quality responses tailored to complex business scenarios. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with IT Experts, Subject Matter Experts, Business stakeholders, and Module Owners to break down complex business logic into domain-specific prompts. How you'll make an impact Develop, refine, and maintain prompt libraries for various transformer units\/factories. Implement advanced techniques like prompt chaining, context injection, and few-shot learning for enterprise-grade accuracy. Own prompt lifecycle management including versioning, traceability, and governance. Evaluate LLM responses for precision, compliance, and bias mitigation. Conduct A\/B testing and maintain performance dashboards for prompt effectiveness. Work closely with Module Owners, Subject Matter Experts, and Business Stakeholders to embed prompts into ACE workflows. Create clear documentation for prompt strategies and maintain best practices aligned with Hitachi Energy's AI Ethics Charter. Stay updated on emerging GenAI technologies, frameworks, and tools to enhance ACE capabilities. Implement and recommend best practices for prompting across different ACE modules. Your background Bachelor or master degree in electrical engineering Experience working in the transformer industry, with international standards and customer documentation. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking. Strong linguistic and logical reasoning for crafting precise prompts. Strong understanding of NLP, context management, and token optimization. Ability to experiment and iterate to optimize outputs. Ability to understand business processes and translate them into ACE-specific prompts. Hands-on experience with LLMs and prompt engineering techniques. Strong interest in AI enterprise-grade solutions. Willingness to learn Python and experience with AI APIs services. Ability to work in Agile environments and manage multiple stakeholders. Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Analytical mindset with attention to detail. Empathy for end users and curiosity for experimentation. Commitment to ethical AI practices and continuous learning. Reduction in prompt failure rate and model hallucination. Improvement in accuracy of outputs by modules. Speed and scalability of prompt deployment across ACE modules within the Transformer Business Unit. Compliance with AI governance and security standards. More about us Be part of a global digital transformation initiative. Work on cutting-edge GenAI solutions. Collaborative culture with opportunities for career growth and innovation. We are committed to full transparency and compliance with all legal requirements, ensuring that every candidate knows exactly what to expect at each stage of the recruitment process. Once the process is successfully completed, we will share detailed information about financial conditions and benefits with the selected candidate. Before signing the employment contract, you will receive all remaining details of the offer, giving you the time and space to review everything carefully. * * Applicable  only for Poland location align with local law regulations

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità Nell'ambito del nostro continuo viaggio di trasformazione digitale, stiamo sviluppando ACE, una piattaforma generativa AI all'avanguardia progettata per migliorare l'efficienza e l'accuratezza del nostro processo di Bid & Propost Management all'interno della Transformers Business Unit.
• Stiamo cercando un Prompt Engineer che svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale in questa iniziativa. Questo individuo sarà responsabile per la progettazione, il test e l'ottimizzazione dei prompt specifici di dominio che consentono ACE di generare output accurati, contestuali e business-aligned. Il ruolo richiede una profonda comprensione dell'industria dei trasformatori, degli standard di attrezzature industriali e della comprensione di base delle migliori pratiche ingegneristiche e del comportamento del modello GenAI, assicurando che ACE offre risposte di alta qualità su misura per scenari aziendali complessi. Il candidato ideale lavorerà a stretto contatto con gli esperti IT, gli esperti di materia principale, le parti interessate di business e i proprietari di moduli per abbattere la logica aziendale complessa in richieste specifiche per il dominio. Come farete un impatto Sviluppare, perfezionare e mantenere librerie rapide per varie unità di trasformatori\/fattori. Implementare tecniche avanzate come la catena rapida, l'iniezione di contesto, e l'apprendimento di pochi colpi per la precisione di livello enterprise. Gestione del proprio ciclo di vita rapido tra cui la versione, tracciabilità e governance. Valuta le risposte LLM per la precisione, la conformità e la mitigazione dei pregiudizi. Condurre test A\/B e mantenere le dashboard delle prestazioni per una rapida efficacia. Lavorare a stretto contatto con i proprietari di moduli, gli esperti di materia principale del soggetto e gli stakeholder aziendali per incorporare i suggerimenti nei flussi di lavoro ACE. Creare una documentazione chiara per le strategie rapide e mantenere le migliori pratiche allineate con la Carta Etica AI di Hitachi Energy. Resta aggiornato sulle tecnologie, i framework e gli strumenti emergenti di GenAI per migliorare le capacità ACE. Implementare e consigliare le migliori pratiche per richiedere diversi moduli ACE. Corso di laurea o master in ingegneria elettrica Esperienza di lavoro nell'industria del trasformatore, con gli standard internazionali e la documentazione del cliente. Forte problem-solving e pensiero analitico. Forte ragionamento linguistico e logico per la realizzazione di precisi suggerimenti. Forte comprensione di NLP, gestione del contesto e ottimizzazione dei token. Capacità di sperimentare e iterare per ottimizzare gli output. Capacità di comprendere i processi aziendali e tradurli in richieste specifiche ACE. Esperienza pratica con LLM e tecniche ingegneristiche rapide. Forte interesse per le soluzioni aziendali AI. Volontà di imparare Python ed esperienza con i servizi AI APIs. Capacità di lavorare in ambienti Agile e gestire più stakeholder. Ottima capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione. Mindset analitico con attenzione ai dettagli. Empatia per gli utenti finali e curiosità per la sperimentazione. Impegno alle pratiche etiche dell'IA e all'apprendimento continuo. Riduzione del tasso di guasto rapido e allucinazione del modello. Miglioramento della precisione delle uscite per moduli. Velocità e scalabilità dell'implementazione rapida tra i moduli ACE all'interno del Transformer Business Unit. Rispetto degli standard di governance e sicurezza AI. Essere parte di un'iniziativa globale di trasformazione digitale. Lavorare su soluzioni GenAI all'avanguardia. Cultura collaborativa con opportunità di crescita e innovazione di carriera. Ci impegniamo a garantire la piena trasparenza e il rispetto di tutti i requisiti legali, assicurando che ogni candidato sappia esattamente cosa aspettarsi in ogni fase del processo di reclutamento. Una volta completato il processo, condivideremo informazioni dettagliate sulle condizioni finanziarie e benefici con il candidato selezionato. Prima di firmare il contratto di lavoro, riceverai tutti i dettagli rimanenti dell'offerta, dandoti il tempo e lo spazio per rivedere tutto con attenzione. * * Applicabile solo per la sede della Polonia allineare con i regolamenti di legge locali

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance Im Rahmen unserer laufenden digitalen Transformation entwickeln wir ACE, eine hochmoderne Generative AI-basierte Plattform, die die Effizienz und Genauigkeit unseres Bid & Proposal Management-Prozesses innerhalb der Transformers Business Unit verbessern soll. Wir suchen einen Prompt Engineer, der eine zentrale Rolle in dieser Initiative spielen wird. Diese Person wird für das Entwerfen, Testen und Optimieren domänenspezifischer Eingabeaufforderungen verantwortlich sein, die es ACE ermöglichen, genaue, kontextbezogene und geschäftsorientierte Ergebnisse zu generieren. Die Rolle erfordert ein tiefes Verständnis der Transformatorenindustrie, Industrieausrüstungsstandards sowie ein grundlegendes Verständnis der prompten technischen Best Practices und des GenAI-Modellverhaltens, um sicherzustellen, dass ACE qualitativ hochwertige Antworten liefert, die auf komplexe Geschäftsszenarien zugeschnitten sind. Der ideale Kandidat wird eng mit IT-Experten, Subject Matter Experts, Business Stakeholdern und Modulbesitzern zusammenarbeiten, um komplexe Geschäftslogik in domänenspezifische Eingabeaufforderungen zu zerlegen. Wie Sie Einfluss haben Entwickeln, verfeinern und pflegen Sie prompte Bibliotheken für verschiedene Transformatoreinheiten / Fabriken. Implementieren Sie fortschrittliche Techniken wie prompte Verkettung, Kontextinjektion und Little-Shot-Learning für Genauigkeit auf Unternehmensebene. Eigenes promptes Lifecycle-Management einschließlich Versionierung, Rückverfolgbarkeit und Governance. Bewerten Sie LLM-Antworten auf Präzision, Compliance und Bias-Abschwächung. Führen Sie A\/B-Tests durch und pflegen Sie Performance-Dashboards für eine sofortige Effektivität. Arbeiten Sie eng mit Modulbesitzern, Fachexperten und Geschäftsinteressenten zusammen, um Eingabeaufforderungen in ACE-Workflows einzubetten. Erstellen Sie eine klare Dokumentation für schnelle Strategien und pflegen Sie Best Practices, die mit der KI-Ethikcharta von Hitachi Energy in Einklang stehen. Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden über neue GenAI-Technologien, Frameworks und Tools, um die ACE-Fähigkeiten zu verbessern. Implementieren und empfehlen Sie Best Practices für Aufforderungen in verschiedenen ACE-Modulen. Ihr Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik Erfahrung in der Transformatorenindustrie mit internationalen Standards und Kundendokumentation. Starkes Problemlösen und analytisches Denken. Starke linguistische und logische Gründe für die Erstellung präziser Eingabeaufforderungen. Starkes Verständnis von NLP, Kontextmanagement und Tokenoptimierung. Fähigkeit zum Experimentieren und Iterieren, um Outputs zu optimieren. Fähigkeit, Geschäftsprozesse zu verstehen und sie in ACE-spezifische Aufforderungen zu übersetzen. Hands-on Erfahrung mit LLMs und prompt Engineering-Techniken. Starkes Interesse an KI Enterprise-Grade-Lösungen. Bereitschaft, Python zu lernen und Erfahrungen mit KI-APIs-Diensten zu sammeln. Fähigkeit, in agilen Umgebungen zu arbeiten und mehrere Stakeholder zu verwalten. Hervorragende Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit Fähigkeiten. Analytische Denkweise mit Liebe zum Detail. Empathie für Endbenutzer und Neugier auf Experimente. Engagement für ethische KI-Praktiken und kontinuierliches Lernen. Reduzierung der prompten Ausfallrate und der Modellhalluzination. Verbesserung der Genauigkeit der Ausgaben durch Module. Geschwindigkeit und Skalierbarkeit der schnellen Bereitstellung über ACE-Module innerhalb der Transformer Business Unit hinweg. Einhaltung von AI Governance- und Sicherheitsstandards. Mehr über uns Be part of a global digital transformation initiative. Arbeiten an innovativen GenAI-Lösungen. Kooperationskultur mit Möglichkeiten für Karrierewachstum und Innovation. Wir verpflichten uns zu vollständiger Transparenz und Einhaltung aller gesetzlichen
• Anforderungen, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder Kandidat in jeder Phase des Einstellungsprozesses genau weiß, was ihn erwartet. Sobald der Prozess erfolgreich abgeschlossen ist, werden wir detaillierte Informationen über die finanziellen Bedingungen und Vorteile mit dem ausgewählten Kandidaten teilen. Bevor Sie den Arbeitsvertrag unterzeichnen, erhalten Sie alle verbleibenden Details des Angebots und geben Ihnen Zeit und Raum, um alles sorgfältig zu überprüfen. * * Gilt nur für Polen Standort mit lokalen Rechtsvorschriften übereinstimmen
descriptionByLocale.fr: L'opportunité Dans le cadre de notre parcours de transformation numérique en cours, nous développons ACE, une plate-forme à la fine pointe de la technologie de l'intelligence artificielle conçue pour améliorer l'efficacité et l'exactitude de notre processus de gestion des soumissions et des propositions au sein de l'unité opérationnelle Transformers. Nous cherchons un ingénieur rapide qui jouera un rôle central dans cette initiative. Cette personne sera responsable de la conception, de l'essai et de l'optimisation d'invites spécifiques au domaine qui permettent à ACE de générer des extrants précis, adaptés au contexte et adaptés aux activités. Le rôle exige une compréhension approfondie de l'industrie des transformateurs, des normes en matière d'équipement industriel ainsi qu'une compréhension de base des meilleures pratiques d'ingénierie rapides et du comportement du modèle GenAI, en veillant à ce qu'ACE fournisse des réponses de haute qualité adaptées à des scénarios d'affaires complexes. Le candidat idéal collaborera étroitement avec les experts en TI, les experts en la matière, les intervenants en affaires et les propriétaires de modules afin de ventiler la logique opérationnelle complexe en indicateurs spécifiques au domaine. Comment vous allez faire un impact Développez, raffinez et maintenez des bibliothèques rapides pour différentes unités de transformateur\/usines. Mettre en œuvre des techniques avancées comme l'enchaînement rapide, l'injection de contexte et l'apprentissage à faible impact pour la précision de l'entreprise. Gestion rapide du cycle de vie, y compris la version, la traçabilité et la gouvernance. Évaluer les réponses à la LLM pour déterminer la précision, la conformité et l'atténuation des biais. Effectuer des essais A\/B et maintenir des tableaux de bord de performance pour une efficacité rapide. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les propriétaires de modules, les experts en la matière et les intervenants commerciaux pour intégrer les invites dans les workflows ACE. Créer une documentation claire pour des stratégies rapides et maintenir les meilleures pratiques alignées sur la Charte d'éthique de l'IA d'Hitachi Energy. Restez au courant des nouvelles technologies, cadres et outils de l'IAGG pour améliorer les capacités de l'ACE. Mettre en œuvre et recommander des pratiques exemplaires pour encourager l'adoption de différents modules ACE. Votre formation Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie électrique Expérience de travail dans l'industrie des transformateurs, avec des normes internationales et la documentation client. La résolution de problèmes et la pensée analytique. Fort raisonnement linguistique et logique pour élaborer des instructions précises. Une bonne compréhension du NLP, de la gestion du contexte et de l'optimisation des jetons. Capacité d'expérimenter et d'optimiser les sorties. Capacité de comprendre les processus opérationnels et de les traduire dans des instructions spécifiques à l'ACE. Expérience pratique des LLM et des techniques d'ingénierie rapides. Fort intérêt pour les solutions de qualité d'entreprise d'IA. Volonté d'apprendre Python et expérience avec les services API AI. Capacité de travailler dans des environnements agiles et de gérer plusieurs intervenants. Excellentes compétences en communication et collaboration. Un état d'esprit analytique avec attention au détail. Empathie pour les utilisateurs finaux et curiosité pour l'expérimentation. Engagement envers les pratiques éthiques en matière d'IA et l'apprentissage continu. Réduction du taux de défaillance rapide et du modèle d'hallucination. Amélioration de la précision des produits par modules. Vitesse et évolutivité du déploiement rapide dans les modules ACE au sein de l'unité de transformation. Conformité aux normes de gouvernance et de sécurité de l'IA. En savoir plus sur nous Participez à une initiative mondiale de transformation numérique. Travail sur les solutions de pointe GenAI. Culture de collaboration avec des possibilités de croissance professionnelle et d'innovation. Nous nous engageons à assurer la pleine transparence et le respect de toutes les exigences légales, en veillant à ce que chaque candidat sache exactement à quoi s'attendre à chaque étape du processus de recrutement. Une fois le processus mené à bien, nous communiquerons des renseignements détaillés sur les conditions et les avantages financiers au candidat sélectionné. Avant de signer le contrat de travail, vous recevrez tous les détails restants de l'offre, vous donnant le temps et l'espace pour examiner tout soigneusement. * * Applicable uniquement pour l'emplacement de la Pologne en conformité avec la réglementation locale

jobs.title: Laboratory Manager – High Voltage Testing 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is the technology leader in design and manufacture of high volt-age transformer bushings. All renowned international companies of the electrical industry, active in power genera-tion, transmission and distribution are among our customers. We have a top position in the high voltage trans-former bushing areas worldwide. In this highly responsible and dynamic role, you will lead our laboratory team at MICAFIL in Zürich-Altstetten (ZH) and ensure that we further strengthen our competitiveness and develop our Swiss branch to meet the global market growth in the field of energy. In this important role, you will continuously drive forward the efficient and innovative processes of our 3 different laboratories together with a strong team. If you have a passion for leadership and high voltage testing, we offer you the stage to bring about real change and actively shape the future of our production processes. How you'll make an impact Lead the laboratory team, including resource management and team development (15 FTE) and act as the point of contact for HV testing at Zürich-Altstetten MICAFIL Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards (IEC\/IEEE) Analyze & implement efficient production & business processes to increase safety, quality and productivity  Ensure high output through reliable high-voltage testing procedures (AC, DC, impulse, partial discharge) Identify and integrate new technologies and best practices to drive the continuous improvement process (CIP) together with your team and our Process Engineering team Collaborate closely with planning, quality assurance, logistics, other production departments and relevant stakeholders for holistic process design and improvement  Be responsible for optimal work and maintenance instructions and other relevant regulations (e.g. ISO, Lean, Six Sigma) Develop and monitor the most important key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure success and re-port to operations manager As People Manager, you will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures and guidelines Your background Technical apprenticeship and qualifications (Bachelor \/ Master) in the field of Electrical Engineering or equivalent Several years of experience in a similar leadership position (High-Voltage Testing\/Insulation Technology\/Power Engineering) Solid knowledge in high-voltage systems, generators, and automation systems Solid knowledge of lean management, Six Sigma and other process optimization methods Proven experience in leading and motivating cross-functional teams Strong problem-solving skills and a data-driven approach to decision making combined with a strong focus on safety Excellent time management, communication and organizational skills Fluent in German and English More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de laboratoire – Essai à haute tension 80 - 100% (f/m/d)

descriptionByLocale.it: L'opportunità Il nostro gruppo di prodotti locale Insulation & Components è il leader tecnologico nella progettazione e produzione di boccole per trasformatori ad alta potenza. Tutte le rinomate aziende internazionali dell'industria elettrica, attive nella produzione di energia, trasmissione e distribuzione sono tra i nostri clienti. Abbiamo una posizione superiore nelle aree boccole trans-former ad alta tensione in tutto il mondo. In questo ruolo altamente responsabile e dinamico, guiderai il nostro team di laboratorio presso MICAFIL a Zürich-Altstetten (ZH) e ti assicurerai di rafforzare ulteriormente la nostra competitività e sviluppare il nostro ramo svizzero per soddisfare la crescita globale del mercato nel campo dell'energia. In questo ruolo importante, continuerai a guidare i processi efficienti e innovativi dei nostri 3 laboratori diversi insieme a un team forte. jobs.title: Field Service Technician (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit Hitachi Energy High Voltage Products ist der weltweit anerkannte Spezialist für Energieübertragung und Energieverteilung. Die Serviceeinheit ist für den weltweiten After Sales Support von Generatorenschutzschaltersystemen (GCB) und gasisolierten Schaltanlagen (GIS) inklusive Schulungen, Installation und Inbetriebnahme, planmäßiger Wartung, Zusatzleistungen, Troubleshooting, Erweiterungen, Umbauten und Austausch zuständig. Service ist der Schlüssel zum Erfolg. Als Kollege\/-in in unserem weltweit tätigen Service Team schätzen Sie die selbstständige, abwechslungsreiche und lösungsorientierte Arbeit. Nach einer vielseitigen, praxisorientierten Ausbildung in der Schweiz und im Ausland, werden Sie rund um den Globus GIS Installationen und Wartungen leiten. Es erwartet Sie eine technisch herausfordernde Stelle in einem multikulturellen Umfeld. Das können Sie bewirken Leitung von multikulturellen Baustellen weltweit für gasisolierte Schaltanlagen für das Spannungslevel von 110KV – 550KV Verantwortlich für die erfolgreiche Durchführung der vor Ort Installation, Wartungen und Reparaturen unter Einhaltung vertraglicher Termine und unter Berücksichtigung lokaler gesetzlicher Vorgaben Verantwortlich für die Qualität der vor Ort ausgeführten Arbeiten mittels Qualitätskontrolle und Beurteilung der Fähigkeiten von lokalen Hilfskräften Durchführen von Produkttraining vor Ort am Produkt und während der Installation Verantwortlich für die Evaluierung von Risiken und deren Minimierung. Koordination und Anweisung von Arbeitskräften Kostenkontrolle der eingesetzten Ressourcen und regelmäßiges Rapportieren an die Projektleitung Aktives Mitarbeiten an Prozessverbesserungen und proaktives Ergreifen von Maßnahmen zur Effizienzsteigerung der Tätigkeiten vor Ort Ihr Hintergrund Abgeschlossene Lehre in der Metallbau-, Elektro- oder Automobilbranche Elektrotechnische Grundkenntnisse sind ein Muss, elektrotechnische Weiterbildung von Vorteil Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Montage- und Inbetriebsetzungsbereich Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse, mindestens B2 Bereitschaft zu nationalen und vor allem internationalen weltweiten Einsätzen mit bis zu 80 % Reisetätigkeit Flexibler, belastbarer und kommunikativer Teamplayer Flair für pragmatische und unkonventionelle Lösungssuche mit hohen Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards Mehr über uns Spannende und abwechslungsreiche 
• Aufgaben mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum Attraktive Möglichkeiten zur Weiterbildung und persönlichen Entwicklung Interessante und vielfältige Tätigkeiten\/Projekte – auch mit Auslandseinsätzen Eingespieltes und dynamisches Team Offene Unternehmenskultur Attraktives Leistungspaket inklusive fixer Vergütung, Reise- und Verpflegungskosten sowie Mitspracherecht bei der Wahl der Unterkunft

descriptionByLocale.it:
Hitachi Energy High Tensione Products è lo specialista riconosciuto a livello mondiale nella trasmissione e distribuzione di energia. L'unità di servizio è responsabile del supporto post-vendita mondiale dei sistemi di interruttori a circuito generatore (GCB) e del commutatore isolato a gas (GIS) tra cui formazione, installazione e messa in servizio, manutenzione programmata, servizi aggiuntivi, risoluzione dei problemi, estensioni, conversioni e sostituzione. Il servizio è la chiave del successo. Come collega del nostro team di assistenza globale, apprezzi il lavoro indipendente, vario e orientato alla soluzione. Dopo una formazione pratica e versatile in Svizzera e all'estero, guiderai installazioni e manutenzione GIS in tutto il mondo. Ti offre una posizione tecnicamente impegnativa in un ambiente multiculturale. Ciò può essere raggiunto dalla gestione di siti di costruzione multiculturali in tutto il mondo per sistemi di interruttori isolati a gas per il livello di tensione di 110KV – 550KV Responsabile per la riuscita dell'implementazione dell'installazione, della manutenzione e delle riparazioni in loco in conformità alle scadenze contrattuali e tenendo conto dei requisiti legali locali Responsabile per la qualità del lavoro svolto in loco attraverso il controllo di qualità e la valutazione delle competenze del personale ausiliario locale Performare la formazione dei prodotti sul posto sul prodotto e durante l'installazione Responsabile per la valutazione dei rischi e la loro minimizzazione. Coordinamento e istruzione della forza lavoro Controllo dei costi delle risorse utilizzate e reporting regolare alla gestione del progetto Cooperazione attiva nel miglioramento dei processi e nell'adozione proattiva di misure per aumentare l'efficienza delle attività sul sito Il tuo background L'insegnamento completo nella costruzione di metalli, nel settore elettrico o automobilistico La conoscenza di base elettrotecnica è un must, elettrotecnica ulteriore formazione di vantaggio Almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale nella zona di montaggio e messa in servizio Molto buone competenze in inglese e tedesco, almeno la disponibilità B2 alle implementazioni nazionali e soprattutto internazionali in tutto il mondo con fino all'80% di attività di viaggio Giocatore di team flessibile, resiliente e comunicativo Flair per una ricerca pragmatica e non convenzionale di soluzioni con elevati standard di qualità e sicurezza
• Compiti con un sacco di corsi creativi Opportunità interessanti per un'ulteriore formazione e sviluppo personale Attività interessanti e diversificate\/progetti – anche con incarichi all'estero Completo e dinamico team Cultura aziendale aperta Pacchetto di servizi attraente tra cui compensazione fissa, costi di viaggio e cibo, nonché la partecipazione alla scelta di alloggi
descriptionByLocale.en:
Hitachi Energy High Voltage Products is the globally recognized specialist in energy transmission and distribution. The service unit is responsible for the worldwide after-sales support of generator circuit breaker systems (GCB) and gas-insulated switchgear (GIS) including training, installation and commissioning, scheduled maintenance, additional services, troubleshooting, extensions, conversions and replacement. Service is the key to success. As a colleague in our global service team, you appreciate the independent, varied and solution-oriented work. After a versatile, practical training in Switzerland and abroad, you will lead GIS installations and maintenance around the world. It offers you a technically challenging position in a multicultural environment. This can be achieved by managing multicultural construction sites worldwide for gas-insulated switchgear systems for the voltage level of 110KV – 550KV Responsible for the successful implementation of on-site installation, maintenance and repairs in compliance with contractual deadlines and taking into account local legal requirements Responsible for the quality of the work carried out on-site by means of quality control and assessment of the skills of local auxiliary staff Performing product training on-site on the product and during installation Responsible for the evaluation of risks and their minimization. Coordination and instruction of workforce Cost control of the resources used and regular reporting to the project management Active cooperation in process improvements and proactive taking of measures to increase efficiency of the activities on site Your background Completed teaching in the metal construction, electrical or automotive sector Electrotechnical basic knowledge is a must, electrotechnical further training of advantage At least 5 years professional experience in the assembly and commissioning area Very good German and good English skills, at least B2 willingness to national and especially international worldwide deployments with up to 80% travel activity Flexible, resilient and communicative team player Flair for pragmatic and unconventional search for solutions with high quality and safety standards More about us Exciting and varied
• Tasks with a lot of creative leeway Attractive opportunities for further education and personal development Interesting and diverse activities\/projects – also with overseas assignments Accomplished and dynamic team Open corporate culture Attractive service package including fixed compensation, travel and food costs as well as participation in the choice of accommodation

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit Als Field Service Engineer bei HITACHI ENERGY LTD bist du für die Installation, Wartung und Reparatur unserer Produkte und Systeme direkt beim Kunden in der Schweiz verantwortlich. Du stellst die optimale Leistung und Verfügbarkeit der Anlagen sicher und leistest damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden. Das kannst du bewirken Durchführung von Installationen, Inbetriebnahmen, Wartungen und Reparaturen an HITACHI ENERGY Produkten und Systemen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Hochspannung, Energieübertragung und -verteilung. Fehleranalyse und -behebung an komplexen elektrotechnischen Anlagen und Systemen. Erstellung von Serviceberichten und Dokumentationen nach jedem Einsatz. Beratung der Kunden bezüglich technischer Fragestellungen und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten. Schulung von Kundenpersonal im Umgang mit den Anlagen. Einhaltung von Sicherheitsvorschriften und Qualitätsstandards. Bereitschaft zu Reisetätigkeiten innerhalb der Schweiz und gelegentlich ins Ausland. Teilnahme am Bereitschaftsdienst (Pikett) ausserhalb der regulären Arbeitszeiten. Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und Aktualisierung des Fachwissens über neue Produkte und Technologien. Dein Hintergrund Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (z.B. Elektriker\/in, Elektroniker\/in, Automatiker\/in) oder Studium (z.B. Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik). Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Service oder Wartung von elektrischen Anlagen, idealerweise in der Energiebranche. Fundierte Kenntnisse in Hochspannungstechnik, Schaltanlagen und Steuerungssystemen sind von Vorteil. Sicherer Umgang mit Mess- und Prüfgeräten. Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (Schweizerdeutsch von Vorteil), sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus. Ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und analytisches Denkvermögen. Hohes Mass an Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Kundenorientierung. Gültiger Führerausweis Kategorie B. Bereitschaft zu flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Reisetätigkeit. Mehr über uns 
• Wir bieten spannende und abwechslungsreiche 
• Aufgaben mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum sowie attraktive Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Dich erwarten interessante und vielseitige Tätigkeiten und Projekte, einschließlich Offshore‑Einsätzen, ein eingespieltes und dynamisches Team und eine offene Unternehmenskultur. descriptionByLocale.en:

Advising customers on technical issues and optimization options. training of customer staff in the handling of the facilities. Compliance with safety regulations and quality standards. Willingness to travel within Switzerland and occasionally abroad. Participation in on-call service (piket) outside regular working hours. Continuous training and updating of expertise on new products and technologies. Good knowledge of German in word and writing (Swiss German is an advantage), as well as good knowledge of English. Knowledge of French is a plus. Strong problem-solving skills and analytical thinking skills. High degree of initiative, responsibility and customer orientation. Valid driving licence category B. jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity   At Hitachi Energy, our purpose is to advance a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to homes, schools, hospitals, and industries — and we do so with people who are passionate, collaborative, and committed to making a real difference. As a SCADA\/RTU Commissioning Engineer, you will join our Grid Automation Systems team in Baden, Switzerland. In this role, you will oversee the commissioning of substation automation systems for medium‑complexity assignments, ensuring all activities are completed safely, efficiently, and in line with contract requirements, quality standards, and safety expectations. How you'll make an impact  
• Carry out testing and commissioning of substation automation systems at customer sites in Switzerland and abroad, while actively supporting the Service Management team
• Execute commissioning activities safely, following all Hitachi Energy and customer safety standards; report hazards and near misses to support continuous improvement
• Perform commissioning tasks according to defined process descriptions and checklists; coordinate closely with engineering and project management teams
• Identify, track, and resolve open points, ensuring customer sign‑off before site demobilization
• Report site progress and planning updates; ensure efficient use of commissioning tools and test equipment
• Provide marked‑up drawings to engineering for preparing as‑built documentation and final submissions
• Support planning and implementation of commissioning activities
• Implement design changes and provide mark‑ups for as‑built project documentation
• Coordinate site activities required to finalize customer acceptance certification   Your background  
• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or equivalent
• 4+ years of experience as a commissioning engineer for automation systems and related products
• Strong knowledge of substation SCADA\/RTU systems, HMI principles, and Hitachi Energy products; understanding of protection philosophies
• Basic knowledge of communication protocols such as IEC 61850, LON, IEC 101–104, DNP; ability to read schematic drawings and identify discrepancies; strong problem‑solving and conflict‑resolution skills
• Familiarity with engineering toolchains typical for SAS\/SCADA (IET600, PCM600, MicroSCADA); willingness to learn across SCADA, RTU, networking, and cybersecurity topics
• Strong communication and presentation skills
• Proficiency in spoken and written English, German is preferred More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe that diversity and collaboration are the foundation of great innovation. You will join a global team where different perspectives are valued, and where we work together to advance a sustainable energy future for all.

jobs.description:
The opportunity In this role, you will plan, prepare, and coordinate all pre‑commissioning, commissioning, and start‑up activities through to successful handover. You will develop and maintain commissioning plans, schedules, manuals, test procedures, and documentation, ensuring all activities meet customer, quality, and regulatory requirements. You will work closely with engineering, project management, and third‑party partners to resolve technical issues, obtain required approvals, and secure customer acceptance. Working independently, you will apply your technical expertise to drive safe, efficient, and compliant commissioning execution while contributing to continuous improvement and supporting the wider project team. How you'll make an impact
• Carry out testing and commissioning of control and relay panels and substation automation systems across various locations in Singapore
• Execute commissioning activities safely in line with Hitachi Energy and customer safety standards, reporting hazards and near misses
• Ensure a positive customer experience and manage customer relationships professionally
• Perform commissioning according to documented processes and checklists, resolving open points and securing customer sign‑off
• Report site progress and planning and ensure efficient use of commissioning assets such as test kits and tools
• Hand over marked‑up drawings for as‑built preparation and final submission to the customer
• Identify and monitor risks in your area of responsibility, ensuring stakeholders remain informed
• Provide guidance to associate commissioning engineers and coordinate tasks with junior staff or small Your background
• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related technical field
• Several years of hands‑on experience in commissioning protection, control, or substation automation systems
• Solid knowledge of protection relays, substation communication protocols (e.g., IEC 61850), and related testing tools
• Strong understanding of safety standards and compliance requirements in utility or industrial environments
• Experience interpreting engineering drawings, schematics, and technical documentation
• Ability to interact confidently with customers, engineers, project managers, and external stakeholders
• Strong problem‑solving skills with the ability to work independently at customer sites More about us At Hitachi Energy, diversity and collaboration are central to how we work. We believe that bringing together different backgrounds, perspectives, and ideas strengthens our teams and drives innovation. You will join a global environment where people support each other, learn from one another, and work together to advance a sustainable energy future for all.

jobs.description: The opportunity At our competence center “Power Converter Solutions”, we have a leading position in the development, manufacturing, installation and commissioning of high power electronic converters mainly for STATCOM and rail power supply systems. We also provide solutions for hydro pump stations and grid interties. With the help of our highly efficient converters, we contribute to the integration of renewable energies into the electrical grid of tomorrow and at the same time increase the overall system efficiency. To strengthen our control engineering team, we are looking for a highly motivated and dedicated Project Control Engineer with interest in power electronics and control technology. You have a quick perception as well as an independent, structured and proactive work style, this is the right challenge for you – join us. How you'll make an impact Project planning of hardware and software for power electronic converters including preparation of concept, specification and documentation Technical coordination between customer, sub-suppliers and our own factory Defining the hardware interfaces including evaluation of electrical components, calculation and design review Responsible for the implementation of the control software including testing on the real-time simulator Perform commissioning and customer training on site Support the sales department during the concept and tender phase Assisting customers on technical issues of the converter during office hours and on-call duty service (24x7) several weeks per year and performing commissioning \/ customer training on site Collaborate with your colleagues from the control, system- and mechanical engineering team as well as the project manager Your background Diploma in Electrical Engineering (university \/ technical college, Bachelor or Master) Working experience in process control and software design (OLC, CLC, Protection, HMI), Ability to code in Python is a plus Knowledge on communication protocols (OPC, IEC61850, IEC60870-5-104, DNP3, etc.) Comprehensive knowledge in the field of control engineering and power electronics You are fluent in German and English You have experience in testing and commissioning and enjoy global traveling and commissioning (15% of the working time) Responsible team player with strong communication skills More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy serves customers in the utility, industry and infrastructure sectors with innovative solutions and services across the value chain. Together with customers and partners, we pioneer technologies and enable the digital transformation required to accelerate the energy transition towards a carbon-neutral future. At Hitachi Energy our purpose is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We bring power to our homes, schools, hospitals, and factories.  Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact to our communities and society. Join us and work with fantastic people, while learning and developing yourself on projects that have a real impact on our communities and society. How you'll make an impact You will lead comprehensive requirements analysis with cross-functional teams to understand user needs and complex system constraints, ensuring alignment with industry standards at Hitachi Energy.  You will engage proactively with key stakeholders to define project objectives and clarify updates, facilitating effective communication and gathering insights for improved project outcomes. You will foster strong relationships with key customers, utilizing their feedback to drive continuous improvement in the mechanical design platform. You will implement newly developed products in a mechanical design platform that ensures high performance and responsiveness, collaborating closely with R&D teams to exceed customer expectations. You need to conduct in-depth risk analysis and develop mitigation strategies to minimize potential impacts on mechanical design platform project timelines and budgets.  You will be supporting champion agile methodologies by organizing regular sprints and retrospectives to enhance team collaboration and adapt to changing requirements.  You will oversee testing and debugging processes to guarantee software quality, utilizing advanced tools to identify and resolve defects effectively.  You will act as a subject matter expert within projects, offering guidance to colleagues. Foster a culture of knowledge sharing by actively distributing insights, best practices, and lessons learned to promote collaboration and continuous innovation within the team. You will be responsible for ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background You hold a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering or a related field. 5-10 years of experience in design engineering with a proven track record of leading design projects. Or a minimum of 5 years of experience in software development within the transformer industry or a comparable technical field. Solid knowledge of Creo modelling (Pro\/Program, Sheet-Metal, Family table, Interchange, Relation, Skeleton, Assembly) Advanced proficiency in programming languages such as C#, Java, Python, VB, C+ or C++, with extensive experience in leveraging software development frameworks to deliver complex solutions. In-depth knowledge of the software development life cycle (SDLC) and agile methodologies, with a proven track record of effectively leading teams through all phases of development. Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills, with the capability to perform comprehensive risk analysis. Ability to bring fresh perspectives and innovative ideas to the design process.  Strong collaborative skills with the ability to foster an environment of innovation and teamwork among colleagues. Willingness to travel and ability to interact with colleagues in different time zones, as position is Global. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Potrai sostenere le metodologie agili del campione organizzando sprint e retrospettive regolari per migliorare la collaborazione del team e adattarsi alle mutevoli esigenze. Conoscenza approfondita del ciclo di vita dello sviluppo software (SDLC) e delle metodologie agili, con una comprovata track record di team leader efficacemente attraverso tutte le fasi di sviluppo. Eccezionale problem-solving e capacità analitiche, con la capacità di eseguire analisi completa del rischio. Capacità di portare nuove prospettive e idee innovative al processo di progettazione. Forte capacità di collaborazione con la capacità di promuovere un ambiente di innovazione e lavoro di squadra tra colleghi. Volontà di viaggiare e capacità di interagire con i colleghi in diversi fusi orari, come la posizione è Global. Eccellente capacità di comunicazione verbale e scritta.
